1280: Kudesha berich hu ashre shemeh benayyhu, veal da al mayya vadday, sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu uf hacha, bemayya badik kahana leitteta, uvishma kaddisha.

(Bamidbar Adonai:17) umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan. man heafar. ha tanenan, ketiv (Kohelet 3:20) hakkol haya min heafar vehakkol shav el heafar hakkol haya min heafar, afillu galgal chamma, kol shekken bar nash deishtechachu minneh.

Amar ribbi yose, illu ketiv umin heafar vela yattir, havina amar hachi. aval kevan dichtiv umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan, mashma deachara hu. ella ketiv (Yeshayahu 41:2) yitten keafar charbo, illen marehon dekistin uvalisterain, mare dedina kashya. mashma dichtiv bekarka hammishkan, daachidan letatta. veal da yikkach hakkohen venatan el hammayim.
Me hammarim hamearrim, illen me yamma, deinnun meririn. may hu. da shema kadisha, beshaata deishtechach bedina, keden ikrun me hammarim hamearrim. uvegin kach mayya deyamma diltatta kullehon meririn.

Ta chaze, hay yamma kadisha kama naharin metikin alin begavvav, uvegin deihi dina dealma, memoy meriran, begin deachid bah mota lechol bene alma. veaf al gav deinnun meriran, kad mitpashshetin metikin innun. lezimnin mayin deyamma meriran. lezimnin yamma devala lechol shear memin, veikre yamma dekafa, uvala kol innun acharanin, veshaiv lon begavivy, vela nigarin levar. lezimnin sharan mayyay, venagdin mehahu yamma, kol ma denagid letattae. uvechamma gevavnin kayyeyma hay yamma. hammayim hamearrim, beshaata deate chivya veatil zuhama, keden hammayim hamearrim veal da kahana avid ovada letatta, veome omaa, veitavid dina.
Ta chaze, i itteta ishtechachat zachyyayta, illen mayin alin begavvav,
Lon innun chulin. kegavvna deyom hashshabbat, delet leh, ella ma dimtakkenin leh beyome dechol.
Uvezimna deshalta ilana dechayyi, itkafyay ilana detov vara, vela yehe leame haaratztzot, ella ma deyahavin lon talmide chachamim, veitkafyayn techotayyhu, ucheillu la havo bealma.

Vehachi isur vehetter, tumea vetahara, la itabbar moamme haaretz. demissitrayyhu let ben galuta limot hamashiach (legabbayyhu) ella shibud malchiyyot bilvad deinnun la taamin meilana dechayyi, vetztzarich lon matnitin beisur veheter tumea vetohora. ella yihon mevuzim kodam talmide chachamim, kegavvna dachashocha kamme nehora, deerev rav innun amme haaretz innun chashuchin. vela itkeriu yisrael, ella avdin zevinin leyisrael, begin deinnun kivirin. veha ukemuha.

Veyisrael itkeriu adam, uminayin deit behon beira veadam. hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 34:31) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem. veatten tzoni tzon mariti, innun amme haaretz, tavin, missitra detov. adam attem, talmide chachamim.

Uvikra da name ramiz leh, (Tehillim 81:14) lu ammi shomea li yisrael vegomer. batar deamar ammi, amay kaamar yisrael. ella ammi: amme haaretz. yisrael: talmide chachamim. uveginayyhu ittemar (Shemot 14:8) uvene yisrael yotztzeim beyad rama.

Kegavvna defalig lon kudesha berich hu betura desinay, hachi palig lon befurekana batrayyta, deyisrael deittemar behon, (Shemot 13:18) vachamushim alu bene yisrael meeretz mitztzerayim. missitra deilana dechayyi, deinnun 50 shenin deyovla. ittemar behon, (Shemot 19:13) hemma yaalu vahar. uvehon (Shemot 14:19) vayyissa malach haelohim haholech lifne machane yisrael. velon ittemar (Shemot 19:4) vaessa etchem al kanfe nesharim, deinnun anane kavod. vaavi etchem elay. uvene yisrael yotztzeim beyad rama, hachi yafik letalmide chachamim, bechol hay yekar.

Uchegavvna deittemar veame haaretz missitra detov, (Shemot 19:17) vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar. hachi yehon bemappekana batrayyta, techot talmide chachamim, keavda deazil leraglayya desuseya demareh. uchegavvna deamar lon betachtit hahar, im tekabbelu torati mutav, veim lav sham tehe kevuratchem. hachi yimma bemappekanu purekana batrayyta, im tekabbelun alechon talmide chachamim bemappekanu degaluta, keadam derachiv al suseya, veavda
1281: Veithappechan metikan, venakan garmah, vekayymin begavvav, ad demitabbera. kevan demitabbera, havo meshappere beshafire leubbara dimaha, venafik bera shappira, naki bela muma dealma. vei lav, innun mayin ayylin begavvav, vearcha recha dezuhama, veinnun mayin mithappechin lechivya bimaha, bema dekilkela itpesat, veitchazze kelana lecholla, veha ukemuha chavrayyay.
Ta chaze, kol innun neshe alma, beatrayyhu kayyme veitdanu, veal da hahu atar mammash deinhu kayyme, beh itdanu. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu, uvae ledakkea lehu.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Tehillim 128:3) eshtecha kegefen poriyya vegomer, ma gefen la mekabbel aleh ella middideh, kach itteta deyisrael, kayyeyma behay gavvna, dela mekabbela alah ella hahu bar zugah. keshappenina (nusach acher ketora) da, dela mekabbela ella hahu bar zugah. veal da kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha. mahu poriyya. kema deat amer (Devarim 29:17) pore rosh. poriyya: porachat, deappikat anafim lechol sitra. vean. beyarkete vetecha, velav levar beshuka, begin dela tete leshakkera bivrit illaa.
Ushelomo amar, (Mishlei 2:17) haozevet alluf neureha veet berit eloheha shachecha. man berit eloheha. hahu atar deikre berit. vehi itkashshera beh, begin kach beyarkete vetecha.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, tuneva lete al hahu bar nash, deshavak leinteteh detitchaze misaara deresha levar. veda hu chad meinnun tzeniuta deveta. veitteta daappikat misaara deresha levar, leittakkena beh, garim miskenuta leveta. vegarim livnaha dela yitchashshevun bedara. vegarim milla achara desharya beveta. man garim da. hahu saara deitchaze mereshah levar. uma beveta hay, kol shekken beshuka, vekol shekken chatzifuta achara. uvegin kach eshtecha kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha.
Dimshammesh leh mutav. veim lav tamman tehe kevuratchem, begaluta.

Veerev rav kegavvna deittemar behon, (Shemot 20:15) vayyar haam vayyanuu vayyaamdu merachok. hachi yehon rechikin min purekana, veyichmun letalmide chachamim, uleama kaddisha bechol hay yekar, veinnun rechikin minnayyhu. vei bau leitchabbera bahadayyhu ma ketiv behu, (Shemot 19:13) lo tigga bo yad ki sakol yissakel o yaro yiyyare. behahu zimna yitkayyem behu beyisrael, (Devarim 32:12) Adonai badad yanchennu veen immo el nechar, veha ukemuha en mekabbelin gerim limot hammashiach. (Shmuel 1 2:9) ureshaim bachoshech yiddamu, innun erev rav. uvegin da amar nevia alayyhu, (Yechezkel 13:9) veel admat yisrael lo yavou.

Amar eliyyahu, raya mehemana, ha shaata ihi lesalleka leella, beomaa imma ant, deha beginach ana bae lesalleka. deyahiv li kudesha berich hu reshu, leitgalyay lach bevet asurim dilach, bikvura dilach, ulemebad immach tivu, deant mecholal bechovin deamma. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 53:5) vehu mecholal mippeshaenu.

Amar leh raya mehemana, beomaa alach bishma diydod, la teacher bechol yecholtach, deha ana betztzaara sagge. (Shemot 2:12) vayyifen ko vacho vayyar ki en ish, ozir li, leappaka li mehay tzaara, behay kevura deittemar alay, (Yeshayahu 53:9) vayyitten et harshaim kivro, vela ishtemodan bi, vaani chashiv beenayyhu ben erev rav rashiayay, kekelev met dessarach benayyhu, dechachmat sofrim tisrach benayyhu, bechol karta vekarta, uvechol atar deyisrael mefuzarin benayyhu ben malkevavn. veithadderu innun erev rav rayayn al yisrael, ana dekudesha berich hu, deittemar behu (Yechezkel 34:31) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem, velet lon yecholet lemebad tivu im talmide chachamim.

Veanshe chayil veyire chet mesovvim meir lair velo yechonanu, umacharimin erev rav benayyhu. vela yahavin lon beatrin saggiin ella davar katztzuv, dela yehe tekuma linfilu dilhon, vaafillu chayyi shaa. vechol chachamim veanshe chayil veyire chet betztzaara bedochaka beyagona, chashivin kichlavim. (Eicha 4:2) banim hamesulaim bappaz echa nechshevu lenivle cheres berosh kol chutztzot. dela ashkachu achsanya benayyhu.
Veinnun erev rav, innun atirin, beshalva, bechedvav, bela tzaara, bela yegona kelal, gazlanin mare shochad, deinnun dayyaynin reshe amma. (Bereshit 6:13) ki mala haaretz chamas
1282: Deitteta deitgalyay, garim saara achara leitgalyay, uleafgema lah. begin kach, baya itteta deafillu tesire deveta, la yechomun saara chad meresha, kol shekken levar.

Ta chaze, kema bidchura saara hu chumera decholla, hachi name lenukeba. puk chame, kama pegimu garim hahu saara deitteta. garim leella, garim letatta, garim levalah deitlatteyay, garim miskenuta, garim milla achara beveta, garim deyistelik chashivuta mibbenaha. rachamana lishezvun, mechatzifu dilhon.

Veal da, baya itteta leitkasseyay, bezivote deveta. vei avdat ken ma ketiv, (Tehillim 128:3) banecha kishtile zetim. mahu kishtile zetim. ma zayit da, ben besitvav, ben bekayyta, la itavidu tarpoy, vetadir ishtechach beh chashivut yatir al shear ilanin. kach benaha yistallekun bachashivu al shear bene alma. velo od ella devalah mitbarech becholla, bevirchan dilella, bevirchan diltatta, beutera, bivnin, bivne benin. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 128:4) hinne ki chen yevorach gaver yere Adonai. uchetiv (Tehillim 128:5-6) yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv yerushalayim kol yeme chayyecha uree banim levanecha shalom al yisrael. (yisrael sava kaddisha)

Mippenehem, alayyhu ittemar (Eicha 1:Adonai) hayu tzareha lerosh. beomaa alach zimna tinyayna, bechay Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael yoshev hakkeruvim, dechol illen millin la yippelun mippumach, bechol yechaltach lemallela behon kamme kudesha berich hu, uleachzaa dochaka dilhon. (ad kan raya mehemana) (emor 89 amud alef ki im betula vechulei)

(Bamidbar 6:2) ish ki yafli lindor vegomer. ribbi elazar patach, (Yeshayahu 50:2) madua bati veen ish vegomer. madua bati. kama chavivin innun yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, divchol atar deinnun sharyayn, kudesha berich hu ishtechach benayyhu, begin dela ade rechimuta dileh minnehon, ma ketiv, (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham. veasu li mikdash setam, dechol be kenishta dealma mikdash ikre. veha ukemuha. ushechinta akdimat leve kenishta.

Zakkaa hahu bar nash deishtechach meinnun asra kadmaa beve kenishta, begin divhu ishtelim ma deishtelim, veinnun mitkaddeshe bekadmita bishchinta. veha ittemar. veha baya deyishtechachu asra bezimna chada beve kenishta. vela yetu piske piske, dela yitakkev shelimu deshayyfin, deha bar nash bezimna chad aved leh kudesha berich hu, veatkin leh kachada kol shayyfe, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:6) hu ascha vaychonanecha. (chaser vezehu hu)

Ta chaze, kevan debar nash ishtelimu shayyfoy, behahu zimna ittakkan lechol shayyfa veshayyfa kaddeka yaut. kegavvna da, kevan dishchinta akdimat leve kenishta, bayayn asra deyishtakkechun tamman kachada, veyishtelim ma deyishtelim. ulevatar deittekan kolla. uvemma hi tikuna decholla. kema deat amer (Mishlei 14:28) berav am haderat melech, veal da amma deatyayn levatar ken, kullehu tikuna degufa.

Vechad atat akdimat shechinta, uvene nasha la atyayn kachada kaddeka yaut. kudesha berich hu kare, madua bati veen ish. may veen ish. dela mittakkene shayyfe, vela ishtelim gufa. dechad gufa la ishtelim, en ish. uvegin kach, veen ish dayyka. veta chaze, beshaata degufa ishtelim letatta, kedusha illaa atya veal behay gufa, veitavid tattaa, kegavvna dilella mammash. ucheden, kolla bayayn dela yiftechun puma bemille dealma. begin deha kayyme yisrael bishlimu illaa, umitkaddeshe bikdushsha illaa, zakkaa chulakehon.

(Bamidbar 6) ish ki yafli vegomer. may ki yafli. deitperash mishshear bene alma, leitkaddesha kegavvna dilella, uleishtakkecha shelim. beshaata devar nash ate leitdakkea, madkin leh. bar nash devae leitkaddesha, mekaddeshin leh. ufarse aleh kedushsha dilella, kedushsha deitkedash bah kudesha berich hu. (chaser)

Ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 103:1) ledavid barchi nafshi et Adonai vechol keravay et shem kadsho. kamma it leh levar nash leistakkela uleminda befulechana demareh, deha bechol yoma veyoma karoza kare veamar, (Mishlei 1:22) ad matay petaim teehavu feti vegomer. (Yirmeyahu 3:22) shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem. velet man deyarkin udeneh, orayyta ka machreza kammayyhu, velet man deyashgach.

Ta chaze, bar nash azil behay alma, vehu chashiv dedileh hu tadir veyishtear begavih ledare darin, ad deihu azil bealma, yahavin leh bekulera, ad deihu yetiv, dayynin leh bekinpon im shear bene dina. i ishtechach leh sanegora, ha ishteziv min dina. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 33:23-24) im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef lehaggid leadam yashro vaychunnennu vayyomer vegomer. man
1283: Hu sanegora. illen ovadin dechashran, dekayyme aleh debar nash beshaata deitzterich leh.

Vei la yishtekach aleh sanegora, ha itchayyayv min dina leistalleka min alma. behahi shaata kad ihu shachiv bekulera demalka, ad dezakif enoy, chama deatyayn legabbeh teren, dechatvin kammeh kol ma deavid behay alma. vechol ma deappik min puma, veyahiv dina (nusach acher chushebana) al kolla vechatvin kammeh. hada hu dichtiv, (Amos 4:13) ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach umaggid leadam ma sicho vegomer. vehu ode alayyhu.

May taama, begin dehahu ovada deihu avid, salleka vekayyeyma aleh leashada beh, vekayymin leashada aleh, vechullehu nachtin veitreshimu kammeh, vekayyme kammeh, vela mitabberan minneh, ad shaata deitdan behu behahu alma. ta chaze, kol innun millin deavid bar nash behay alma, kullehu zeminin vekayyme leashada beh, vela itavidu minneh. uveshaata demappeke leh lekivra, kullehu mitattedan veazle kammeh. utelat karoze machreze. chad kammeh, vechad mimineh, vechad missemaleh. veamre da pelanyay demarid bemareh. marid leella, marid letatta, marid beorayyta, marid befikudoy. chamu ovadoy, chamu milloy, tav leh dela ivre.

Ad demate legabbe kivra, kullehu metin itragzun midduchetayyhu aleh, veamre vavy vavy deda itkevar begavvavn. ovadoy umilloy akdeman vealin lekivra, vekayyme aleh dehahu gufa, verucheh azla veshat, umitabbela al gufa. kevan debar nash ittemar beve kivre, duma kadim (sefer acher kaim) venafik techot yedeh, telata be dina, di memanan al dina dekivra, utelat sharvite deeshsha bidayyhu, vedayynin rucha vegufa kachada. vavy al hahu dina, vavy al ovadoy.
Beshaata deihu tafis bekulera demalka, veittedan dineh, veishtelim, dela ishtechach aleh sanegorya. vesantira demalka nachit, vekaim kameh, leragloy, vechad sayyfa shinnana bideh.

Zakif bar nash enoy, vechame kotle beta demitlahatan beeshsha (deziva) minneh addehachi chame leh kammeh kuleh male ayynin, levushe eshsha delahit kammeh devar nash. hachi hu vadday, deha kama bene nasha chamu malacha beshuka, vekayyme kammeh, ushear bene nasha la chaman leh.

Vei tema, ha ketiv (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot vegomer. hech yachil leitchazaa beara. ella milla da, ha ukemuha, dechevan denachit malacha leara, itlebash begufa, veitchazze leman deitchaze, behahu levusha deitlebash beh. vei lav, la yachil lemisbal leh alma uleitchazaa. kol shekken vechol shekken hay dechol bene alma tzerichin leh.

Telat tippin becharbeh vechulei, veha ukemuha chavraya. kevan dechame leh, izdaza kol gufeh verucheh, velibbeh la shachich, begin deihu malka dechol gufa. verucha dileh azla bechol shayyfe gufa, veishteil minnayyhu, kevar nash deishteil mechavreh, lemehach laatar achara. keden hu omer vavy al ma deavad, vela mehaneyay leh, ella i akdim asvavta ditshuva, ad la mata hahi shaata.

Dachil hahu bar nash, uvae leittammera vela yachil. kevan dechame dela yachil, hu patach enoy, veit leh leistakkela beh, veistakkal beh beayynin pekichin. ucheden hu masir garmeh venafsheh. vehahu shaata, hu iddan dedina rabba, debar nash ittedan beh behay alma. ucheden rucha azla bechol shayyfe gufa, veishteil minayyhu, veshat bechol shayyfin, veizdazea lechol sitrin vechol shayyfe gufa kullehu mizdazean.
Kad mata rucha lechol shayyfa veshayyfa, veishteil minneh. nafal zia al hahu shayyfa, verucha istalik minneh. umiyyad mit hahu shayyfa. vechen bechullehu.

Kevan demate rucha lemeppak, deha ishteil mikkol gufa, keden shechinta kayyeyma aleh. umiyyad parcha min gufa. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitdevak bah, vavy leinnun chayyayvayya dirchikin minnah, vela mitdabbekin bah.

Vechamma be dina abar bar nash kad nafik mehay alma. chad hahu dina illaa dekaamaran, kad nafik rucha min gufa. vechad dina, kad ovadoy umilloy azlin kammeh, vecharoze machreze aloy. vechad dina, kad ayel lekivra
1284: Vechad dina dekivra. vechad dina detolaatta. vechad dina degehinnam. vechad dina derucha deazla veshat bealma, vela ashkach atar, ad deyishtelimu ovadoy. vday shiva idanin yachlefun aloy. begin kach bae bar nash, kad ihu ishtechach behay alma, ledachala min mareh, uleistakkela bechol yoma veyoma beovadoy, veyetuv minnayyhu kamme mareh.

Kad istekal david malka beinnun dinin devar nash, kad istallak mehay alma, akdim veamar, (Tehillim 103:1) barachi nafshi et Adonai, ad dela tippuk mealma, hasheta deant ishtechachat im gufa. vechol keravay et shem kadsho, attun shayyfe demishtattefe berucha, hasheta deishtechachat immechon, akdimu levarcha shema kaddisha, ad la yimte zimna, dela techllun levarcha leh, uleodaa alayychu.

Ta chaze ish ki yafli lindor neder, nazir deakdim behay alma, leitkaddesha bikdusha demareh (Bamidbar 6:3) miyyayin veshechar yazzir chometz yayin vegomer. hacha it leistakkela, kevan deasir leh chamra, anavim lamma. deha bechahane ketiv yayin veshechar al tesht vegomer, yachol anavim name la, baanavim share. hacha lannazir, may tama asar leh anavim.

Ella, ovada da, umilla da, raza illaa hu, leitparsha min dina becholla. veha yedia hahu ilana dechav beh adam kadmaa, anavim havo. veda hu raza demilla, deha yayin veshechar vaanavim, besitra chad itachadu. yayin leella veokmuha. shechar lismala, deha shechar miyayin nafka. anavim dechanish kullehu legabbayyhu, veda hu ilana dechav beh adam kadmaa. begin kach kolla bechad sitra itachad. vei tema dehay nazir shavik mehemnuta illaa. (sefer acher kelum) lav hachi, ella la itchaze beh ovada missetar semala kelum.

Ta chaze, dehachi olifna missifra derav hamenuna sava, vehachi hu. ketiv gaddel pera sear rosho, bae deyyitrebe sear resheh vedikneh, veyitperish miyayin veshechar vaanavim, begin dechullehu setar semala, vela talyayn saara. yayin imma illaa. shechar sitra daachidu beh levae venafke miyayin illaa vela tale saara. uvegin kach kad seliku levae lehahu atar, baayayn leavera kol saara dilhon, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 8:7) veheeviru taar al kol besaram. (121 amud bet).

Anavim imma tattaa, dechanish yayin veshechar legavvav, veal da itperash mikkol setar semala, dela leachazaa ovada dilhon legabbeh. anavim da la tale saara vedikna. deha nukeba bayay lesappera saara, kad atya leizdavvevga bidchura, veha dikna la ishtechach bah. begin kach hu tale saara deresha vedikna, veraza demilla (Shoftim 13:5) nezir elohim ikre, vela nezir Adonai, parish middina kolla.

Ta chaze, al da ketiv, vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh vegomer. al nafsho la ketiv, ella al hannafesh setam. umay ihu. da anavim, deikre nefesh. veal da ketiv chata, begin distar dileh yayin veshechar hu, vegara minneh atar dina. chata, may chata. ella gara dina shel hannefesh.

I hachi, amay vechipper alav. begin dehashta ka atya leitchabbera bahadayyhu, vela mekabbelan leh hane atre, ad deyimmalech bechahana, vichapper aleh, begin deihu shade lon levar bekadmita, kevan dehashta ate legabbayyhu, bae leitchabbera tikkuna dechappara, vikabbelun leh, veda hu raza demilla. (vadday becholla).

Vei tema, shimshon nezir elohim hava, amay itannash. ella shappir hu milla, devaal bat el nechar. vahava leh leitchabbera bedideh, bema deitchaze leh. vehu dehava kaddish, arav hahi kedushsha bevat el nechar, veshavik atreh, deitchaze lehahi kedushsha, uvegin kach itannash.
Veit man deamar, delet leh chulaka behahu alma. may tama begin deamar (Shoftim 16:30) tamut nafshi im pelishtim, umasar chulakeh bechulaka diflishtae, diyyemut nafsheh immehon behahu alma. kach
1285: Havo machreze al nezira, lech lech amrin nezira, sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav. veha ukemuha chavrayyay.

1290: Admich vela naim. ena dehu netura decholla. ena dehu kiuma decholla. veal hay ketiv (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach, al tikre yevorach ella yevarech. dehay itkere tov ayin, uminneh mevarech lecholla.

Vetana, let nehiru leena tattaa, leistachaa meadmimuta meuchamuta bar kad chazi (sefer acher itchaze) (sefer acher itsache) mehay nehora chivvavra deena illaa deikre tov ayin. velet deyada kad nahir ena illaa da kaddisha veasche leena tattaa da. bar ihu.

Uzeminin tzaddikayyay, zakkae elyonin, lemecheme da berucha dechachmeta, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 52:8) ki ayin beayin yiru. ematay. beshuv Adonai tziyyon. uchetiv (Bamidbar 14:14) asher ayin beayin nira atta Adonai. veilmale ena tava illaa, deashgach veasche leena tattaa, la yachil alma lemekam riga chada.
Tana bitzniuta desifra, ashgachuta deena tattaa, kad ashgach nehiru illaa beh, veayil hahu nehiru deillaa betattaa. demineh nahir kolla hada hu dichtiv asher ayin beayin nira atta Adonai.

Ketiv (Tehillim 33:18) hinne en Adonai el yereav. uchetiv (Zecharya 4:10-11) ene Adonai hemma meshottim bechol haaretz. zachu, ene Adonai el yereav, ena dilella. la zachu, ene Adonai hemma meshottot, ena diltatta.

Detanya, mippene ma zacha yosef dela shalta beh ena bisha, mippene shezzacha leishtaggecha beena tava illaa, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:22) ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin. amay hu ben porat. ale ayin. kelomar al sibbat ayin deishtegach beh.

Uchetiv tov ayin hu yevorach, may tama. ki natan millachmo laddal. may tama ikre chad. ta chaze, beeneh detattaa it ena yemina, veit ena dismala. veinnun tere, bitre gevavne. aval hacha, let ena semala. vetarvavyyhu bedarga chad salke, vecholla yemina. uvegine kach, ena chad, vela teren.

Vetana, ena da, dehu ena deashgachuta. pekicha tadir. chayychan tadir. vechaddan (sefer acher vachezaan) tadir, dela havi hachi letattaa, dichlilan besumaka uveuchama uvechivvavra, beg gevavne, vela hava tadir pekicha (sefer acher dilleh gabeynea) delet gavhana sutera (sefer acher keleha gevine sudara) (sefer acher dilleh eneha bagebaynay damekasean) al ena. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 44:24) ura lamma tishan Adonai. (Melachim 2 19:16) pekach Adonai enecha.

Kad itpekach, it leman deitpekach letav. uleman dela itpekach letav. vavy leman deitpekach veena itarav besumaka, vesumaka itchaze lokovleh, umechasseya ena. man yishteziv minneh. aval attik yomin, tava deena. chivvavr bego chivvavr. chivvavr dechalil kol chivvavre. zakkaa chulakeh, leman deyishgach illavih, chad chivvavr minnayyhu. veal da vadday ketiv tov ayin hu yevorach. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 2:Adonai) bet yaakov lechu venelcha beor Adonai.

Tana, (im kol da) shemeh deattika satim mikkolla, vela mitperash beorayyta, bar min atar chad, deome zeer appin leavraham, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:16) bi nishbati neum Adonai. neum dizer appin. uchetiv, (Bereshit 48:20) becha yevarech yisrael, yisrael dilella. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar, leyisrael kaamar da. vetanenan attik yomin amaro vehay vehay shappir.
Tanya, ketiv (Daniel 7:9) chaze havit ad di karsavavn remiv veattik yomin yetiv. karsavavn remiv, man hu. amar lerabbi yehuda, kum bekiyyumach veatkin karseyay da.

Amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv (Daniel 7:9) korseyeh shevivin dinur. veattik yomin yetiv al hay kurseyyay. may tama. detanya i attik yomin la yativ al hay karseyyay, la yachil leitkayyeyma alma, mikkamme hahu kuresyay. kad yetiv attik yomin aleh lekafyay (sefer acher itkafyay) lehahu kuresyyay, uman derachiv shallit. beidana denatil mehay kurseyay, veyativ al kuresyay achara, kuresyay kadmaa remiu, dela shalta ella ihu derachiv beh attik yomin. amar ribbi shimon leribbi yehuda, yittekkan archach, veyete bach meattik yomin.
Veta chaze ketiv (Yeshayahu 41:4) ani Adonai rishon veet acharonim ani hu. kolla hu, vehu satim mikkol sitroy. (behay) chotama. tana, bechotama ishtemoda partzufa.
1291: Ben attika, lizer appin. da mareh dechotama mechad nukeba chayyin, umechad nukeba chayyin dechayyin. hay chotama. hu pardashka, deveh nashiv rucha dechayye, lizer appin. vekarenan leh selicha. vehu nachat ruach, itbassemuta derucha.

Derucha denafik (mehacha) meinnun nukeve, chad rucha nafik lizer appin. leatteara (sefer acher chayyin mikkol sitrin, cheru mikkol sitre, chayyin dechayyin) leh beginta deeden. vechad rucha dechayye, deveh zammin lezamana livreh dedavid, leminda chachmeta. umehahu nukeba, ittear venafik rucha mimmocha setimaa, vezammin leashraa al malka meshicha, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:2) venacha alav ruach Adonai ruach chachma uvina ruach etza ugevura ruach daat veyirat Adonai. ha hacha 4 ruchin, veha rucha chada amrenan. amay telat. kum ribbi yose bekiyyumach.

Kam ribbi yose veamar. beyomoy demalka meshicha, la yemrun chad lechad, alif li chachmeta, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:34) velo yelammedu od ish et reehu vegomer, ki chullam yedu oti lemikketannam vead gedolam. uvehahu zimna, yittear attik yomin, rucha denafik mimmocha setimaa decholla, vechad yishlof da, kol ruchin diltatta yittearun immeh. uman innun. innun (teren) kitrin kaddishin dizer appin. veinnun shita ruchin acharanin, deyahave (sefer acher dehachi) innun (sefer acher shita ruchin, 3 ruchin inun dakelaleynen telat acharanin) dichtiv ruach chachma uvina ruach etza ugevura ruach daat veyirat Adonai.

Detanenan, ketiv (divrei hayamim 1 29:23) vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai. uchetiv (Melachim 1 10:19) shesh maalot lakkisse. umalka meshicha zammin lemetav beshiva. shita innun verucha deattik yomin dealayyhu, ha shiva. kema deittemar. (3 ruchi inun dakelaleynen 3 acharanin) amar leh rabbi shimon, ruchacha yanuch lealma deate.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Yechezkel 37:9) ko amar Adonai (Bereshit 139 amud alef, 235 amud alef) mearba ruchot boi haruach vegomer. vechi arba ruche alma, may avde hacha. ella arba ruche yittearun. 3 innun. verucha deattika setima arba, vehachi havo. dechad yippuk da, nafkin immeh telata, dichlilan bego telata acharanin.

Vezammin kudesha berich hu leappaka chad rucha dechalil mikkullehu. dichtiv mearba ruchot boi haruach. arba ruchot boi la ketiv kan, ella mearba ruchot boi. uveyome demalka meshicha, la yitztarchun lemelaf chad lechad, deha rucha dilhon dechalil mikkol ruchin. yedia kolla. chachma uvina etza ugevura (ruach) daat veyirat Adonai. mishshum rucha dichlila mikkol ruche. begin kach ketiv, mearba ruchot, deinnun arba dichlilan beshiva dargin illain deamaran. vetana, dechullehu kelilan behay rucha deattika deattikin, denafik mimmocha setimaa lenukeba dechotama.

Veta chaze, ma ben chotama lechotama. chotama deattik yomin chayyin mikkol sitroy. chotama dizer appin, ketiv, (Shmuel 2 22:9) ala ashan beappo veesh mippiv tochel vegomer. ala ashan beappo, umehahu ashan dalik nur, kad salik tenana levatar. gechalim baaru mimmennu. mahu mimmennu (3 navesachey). meoto ashan. mehahu chotama, mehahu eshsha.

Tana, kad hava rav hamenuna sava bae letzallaa tzeloteh, amar levaal hachotem ani mitpalel, levaal hachotem ani mitchannen. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 48:9) utehillati echotam lach, hay kera leattik yomin amaro.

Tana, orcha dechotama, telat mea 81 almin, itmalleyayn min hahu chotama. vechullehu mitdabbekin bizer appin. hay tushebachta detikkuna dechotama hu. vechol tikkune deattik yomin, itchazun vela itchazun, itchazun lemare middin, vela itchazun lecholla.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, vavy man deoshit yedoy bedikna yakkira illaa, desava kaddisha, temira usetima (nusach acher tamir vesatim) mikkolla dikna dehahi tushebachta. dikna desatim veyakkir mikkol tikkunoy. dikna dela yadin illain vetattain. dikna dehi tushebachta dechol tushebachin. dikna dela havi bar nash nevia vekaddisha deyikrav lemecheme leh. dikna dehi talyay besaaroy ad tabbura delibba. chivvavra ketalga yakkira deyakkirin. temira ditmirin. mehemnuta dimhemnuta decholla.
1292: Desifra, dehay dikna mehemnuta decholla, nafik meudenoy, venachit socharaneh defuma kaddisha, venachit vesalik vechafe, betakruveta (saggi) devusema tava, chivvavra deyakkira (sefer acher dabedaykaneyh). venachit (sefer acher chivvavra yakkira dadeykenayh nachit) beshikkula, vechafe ad tabbura. hu dikna yakkira, mehemana shelema, denagdin beh 13 neviin, mabbuin dimshach revut tava, bitlat asar tikkunin mittakkena.
Tikkuna kadmaa. mittakken saara milleella, veshari mehahu tikkuna disar resheh, desalik betikkunoy leella meudenoy, venachit mikkamme pitcha deudenin, bechad chuta beshikkula tava, ad resha defuma.
Tikkuna tinyayna. mittakkan saara meresha defuma, (vesalik) ad resha achara defuma, betikkuna shakil.

Tikkuna telitaa. meemtzaita ditchot (sefer acher dehay) chotama, mittechot teren nukevin, nafik chad orcha, vesaara itpesak behahu archa, umalya mehay gisa, umehay gisa saara, metikkuna shelim socharaneh dehahu orcha.
Tikkuna reviaa. mittakkan saara (venachit) techot puma, meresha chada leresha chada, betikkuna shelim.
Tikkuna chamishaa. techot puma nafik archa achara, beshikkula dearcha dilella, veillen teren archin reshimin al puma, mikkan mikkan.
Tikkuna shetitaa. mittakken saara, vesalik venafik millera leel leresha defuma. vechafe takruveta devusema tava, ad resha defuma dilella. venachit saara leresha defitcha deorcha tattaa defuma.
Tikkuna sheviaa. pasik saara, veitchazn teren tappuchin, betakruveta devusema tava, shappiran veyaan lemechoze. beginehon itkeyaym alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 16:15) beor pene melech chayyim.
Tikkuna teminaa. nafik chad chuta desare socharane dedikna, vetalyayn beshikkula ad tabbura.
Tikkuna teshiaa. mitare umitarvin sare dikna, im innun sare detalyayn beshikkula, (detalyayn) vela nafke da min da.
Tikkuna ashiraa. (mitarvin) nachtin sare techot dikna. vechappeyayn bigrona techot dikna.
Tikkuna chad sar. dela nafkin nima min nima, umitsharan beshiura shelim.
Tikkuna teresar. dela talyayn sare al puma, ufuma itpene mikkol sitroy. veyaan sare sechor sechor leh.

Tikkuna telesar. detalyayn saaran bitchot dikna, mikkan umikkan, bikara yaa, bikara shappira. mechappeyayn ad tabbura. la itchaze (sefer acher leitchazaa) mikkol anpe takruva devusema, bar innun tappuchin shappirin chivvavrin, demappikin chayyin lealma, umechazyayn chedu lizer appin.

Bitlesar tikkunin illen, nagdin venafkin telesar mabbuin dimshach revut, venagdin lechol innun diltatta. unehirin behahu mishcha. umeshichin mehahu mishcha, devitlesar tikkunin illen. bitlesar tikkunin illen itreshim dikna yakkira, setimaa decholla, deattik deattikin. mittere tappuchin shappiran deanpoy, nehirin anpoy dizer anpin, vechol chivvavr (sefer acher chayzaver) veshushan deishtachchan letatta, nehirin umitlahatin mehahu nehora dilella. tikkunin telesar illen, ishtechachu bedikna, uvishlemut dikna betikkunoy, itkere bar nash neeman. dechol dechame dikneh, tale beh mehemnuta.

Tana bitzniuta desifra, telesar tikkunin illen detalyayn bedikna yakkira, bishviaa (minnehon) mishtakkeche bealma, umitpatteche bitlesar tare derachame. uman deoshit yedeh leumaa, keman deome bitlesar tikkune dikna. hay baarich appin. bizer appin bechamma. amar leribbi yitzchak, kum bekiyyumach, vesalsel besalsela detikkuna demalka (sefer acher badekna) kaddisha heach yittakkenun.

Kam ribbi yitzchak, patach veamar, (Micha 7:20) mi el kamocha nose avon vegomer, yashuv yerachamenu vegomer, titten emet leyaakov vegomer. tana, telesar mechilin itchazun hacha, vechullehu nafkin mittelesar mabbuin dimshach revut detikkune
1293: Dikna kaddisha, attika deattikin. temira ditmirin. tana, tikkuna dedikna tamir vesatim, tamir vela tamir. satim vela satim. betikkunoy yedia vela yedia.
Tikkuna kadmaa. ha tanenan, dechol saara vesaara vechol nima venima la mitdabbeka lechaverta. veshaaru nimin dedikna leatkena, metikkuna disar resha.

Hacha it leistakkela, i kol nimin disar resha, venimin dedikna yakkira illaa, bechad nima itkelalu, (sefer acher bechad matkela itkalu) amay illen arichin, veillen la arichin. amay (140) nimin dedikna la arichin kule hay, vekashyayn. veillen deresha la kashyayn, ella sheiin.

Ella, kol nimin shekilin deresha vedikna. deresha arichin al katfin, lemegad leresha (davar acher meresha) dizer appin, mehahu meshicha democha, lemocha dileh. uvegine kach la havo kashyayn. veal da itchazun lemehevi rechiche.

Tana, may (78 amud alef, 140 amud alef, 262 amud alef) dichtiv, (Mishlei 1:20) chachmot bachutz taronna. ulevassof ketiv, barchovot titten kolah. hay kera lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. ella chachmot bachutz taronna, kad nagid mimmocha setimaa daarich appin, lemocha dizer appin, beinnun nimin. keillu mitchabberan levar, teren (Bereshit 141 amud bet, 140) mochin, veitavid chad mocha, begin delet kiuma lemocha tattaa, ella bekiyyuma democha illaa. vechad nagid mehay lehay, ketiv titten kolah chad.

Uvegin denagid mimmocha lemocha beinnun nimin (keillu mitchabberan levar teren mochin veitavid chad mocha beinnun nimin) innun la ishtechachu keshishin. may tama. mishshum dei ishtakkechu keshishin, la nagid chachmeta lemocha behon. begine kach, let chachmeta nafka mibbar nash deihu keshisha (sefer acher kashya) umare derugeza. dichtiv, (Kohelet 9:17) divre chachamim benachat nishmaim. umehacha olifna, man desaroy deresheh keshishan, lav chachmeta mityashsheva immeh.

Veal da innun ariche, lemete toalta lecholla. may lecholla. lemeal al chuta deshidra, demitshakyayn min mocha. uvegin da la tale saara deresha al saara dedikna. desaara deresha tale vesalik al udenin laachoroy, vela tale al dikna, mishshum dela itzterich leitarva illen beillen. dechullehu mitparshan bearchayyhu.

Tana, kullehu sare ben deresha, ben dedikna, kullehu chivvavre ketalga. vetana, inhu dedikna keshishae kullehu. may tama. mishshum deinnun takkifa detakkifin, leachasin (nusach acher laachata) innun 13 mechilan, meattik deattikin. vahane mechilan mikkamme udenoy sharyayn, vahane mechilan setiman innun. dela yitarvun beacharanin. (daatachesaynav letatta vehachi tinyana mikkamme avedanevay sharyayn shaare mishshum dabelachevadeyyhav inun velo itarvu baacharenayn).

Vei tema delet acharanin kevavtayyhu. la. detanya telesar mechilan derachame meattika kaddisha: mi el kamocha, chad. (140) nose avon, tere. veover al pesha, telat. lisherit nachalato, arba. lo hechezik laad appo, chamesh. ki chafetz chesed hu, shit. yashuv yerachamenu, shiva. yichbosh avonotenu, temanya. vetashlich bimtzulot yam kol chattotam, tisha. titten emet leyaakov, asra. chesed leavraham, chad sar. asher nishbata laavotenu, teresar. meme kedem, telesar. lokovel da, el rachum vechannun vegomer, innun letatta.

Vei tema, moshe ech la amar illen illain. (138) ella, moshe la itzterich, ella leatar dedina ishtechach, uvaatar dedina ishtechach, la bae hachi lememar. umoshe la amar, ella beidana deyisrael chavu, vedina hava talyay, uvegine kach la amar moshe, ella baatar dedina ishtechach. aval behay atar, sidura dishvacha deattik yomin mesadder nevia.

Veinnun telesar tikkunin dedikna illaa kadisha, temira ditmirin, takkifin, letavra uleachpeyay kol gizre dinin. man chame dikna illaa kaddisha, temira ditmirin dela achsif (132) (sefer acher itkesse) minneh. uvegin kach, kol saaroy keshishin, vetakifin betikkunoy.
1294: Vei tema, i hachi ha sare diltatta, innun uchame, amay la havo da keda. detanya ketiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:11) kevutztzotav taltallim shechorot kaorev. uchetiv, (Daniel 7:9) usear resheh kaamar neke. la kashya, ha bedikna illaa, ha bedikna tattaa. veal da, kad ityeyhivat orayyta leyisrael, ityeyhivat beesh shechora al gabbe esh levana. veikkara demilla mishshum dehane sare begin demimmocha ishtechachu leitmashshecha lemocha diltatta veinnun leella min dikna dikna bilchodoy hu. vechol tikkunoy bilchodehon ishtechachu. dikna bilchodoy. veshare bilchodayyhu.

Tikkuna kadmaa tikkuna deshari meresha desaare deresha. vetana, kol tikkune dikna la ishtechach ella (machevamea delibba) mimmocha deresha, (sefer acher mateykevaney deresha) vehacha la parish hachi, deha la havi. ella tikkuna da, denachit min resha desare deresha, hachi ishtechach. (chaser kan)
Umehay dikna ishtemoda, kol ma dahavi beresha, deelef almin dechattimin (sefer acher elef almin chatimin) beizka dedachya. izka, dechalil kol izkin.

Orka dechol saara, denachit mikkamme udenoy, la havi aricha. vela itdevak da beda, vela (sefer acher decholla) nachtin. illen saarin. mikkad nagdin itmashshechan (sefer acher ella mikkad nachtin illen, seorin. nagdin veitmashshechan) vetalyayn.
Veshiruta detikkuna kadmaa, telatin vechad kotze, shekilan, itmashshechan ad resha defuma. utelat mea vetishin nimin ishtakkechan bechol kotza vekotza.

Telatin vechad kotze shekilin, dahavu betikkuna kadmaa takkifin, leachpeyay letatta, kechusheban el. mahu el. takkif yachol. uvechol kotza vekotza, mitparshin telatin vechad almin, takkifin shaltin, leitayyna (sefer acher leitpashsheta) (sefer acher leachfeya, veitpashatu) 31 behay setar, velo behay setar. vechol alma vealma minneh, mitperash leelef almin dichsifin leidduna rabba. vecholla satim beresha dedikna, dechalil takkifa, uchelilan behay el. veim kol da, hay el itkafyay lerachame, derachame deattik yomin, (itbesam) veitkelal veitpashshat beh.

Amay ad puma. mishshum dichtiv, (Daniel 7:10) dina yetiv vesifrin vegomer. may dina yetiv. yetiv leatreh dela shalta. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 9:Adonai) pele yoetz el gibbor. el dehu gibbor, veitbesam bediyyukena (sefer acher badekna) kaddisha deattik yomin. veraza dichtiv, mi el kamocha beattik yomin ittemar, betikkuna kadmaa dedikna kaddisha illaa.
Alma kadmaa, denafik metikuna kadmaa, shallit venachit. vesalik leelef alfin veribbo ribbevan mare terisin. uminneh mitachadin, bekista beizka rabba.
Alma tinyayna. denafik mehay tikkuna. shallit venafik, venachit vesalik, leshiva vechamshin elef dargin, mare divava. umitachadan minneh, leachpeyay bekudela bechivvara. (sefer acher bacheyzeraa)

Alma telitaa. denafik mehay tikkuna shallit venachit, vesalik 126 alfin mare dilala, umitachadan minneh (babevaseytea lakevasetayraa) (sefer acher kabevaseynea lakevaseraa) (babevatzeynea kamevarea), umehay tikkuna, mitkafyayn kullehu, umitbasseman bimrira dedimin, demitbassemin beyamma rabba.

Man chame tikkuna da, dedikna kaddisha, illaa, yakkira, dela achsif minneh. man chame temiruta (sefer acher ykeyrevatea) dekotzin desare detalyayn mehay sava. yetiv beitra deitrin, itrin dechol itrin. itrin dela itkalalu beitrin. itrin dela kishar itrin. itrin, deitrin diltatta mitachadan minnehon. uvegin kach, hane tikkunin, innun tikkunin diltatta minnehon mitachadin.

Tikkune deittekan, deitzterich leitbarcha, man devae beracha. dechol tikkunin deittekan bekavlehon, birchan mishtakkechin (lokovlehon) veitavid ma deitavid. kolla kalil behane tikkunin. kolla zakfan lakavle tikkunin demalka takkifa, attika, setima decholla. vechullehu itbasseman mittikkunin illen. (demalka attika)

Tana. i attik deattikin, kaddisha dekaddishin, la ittekkan beillen tikkunin, la ishtechachu illain vetattain. vecholla havi kolla havi. vetanya, ad kama zehirin illen (sefer acher ittakkan beillen 33) tikkune dedikna. ad telesar (diltatta), vechol zimna
1295: Ditlesar illen mishtakkechin, zehirin illen diltatta. vecholla. bechushebana deillen telesar, ishtechach dikna demalka attika yakkira mikkolla. kolla bechad ihu temira veyakkira.

Uvegin deihu yakkira utemira mikkolla, la idkar beh beatar deorayyta (sefer acher lo idkar beorayyta), vela itgalyay. uma dikna itgalyay. dikna dechahana rabba illaa. umehay dikna, nachit ledikna dechahana rabba diltatta. (may dikna dechahana Rava) dikna dechahana rabba bitmanya tikkunin ittakkan. uvegin kach, temanya tikkunin lechahana rabba, kad mishcha nachit al dikneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:2) kashemen hattov al harosh yored al hazzakan vegomer.

Vmna lan. dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:1) shevet achim gam yachad. gam lerabbot kohen gadol diltatta. dechol zimna dechahana rabba diltatta, meshammesh bichhuna rabba, kivyachol kohen gadol dilella, meshammesh bichhuna rabba.

Da tikkuna chad, dedikna deattika setima decholla. amar leh ribbi shimon, yaut ant ribbi yitzchak, lemecheme beyakira detikkune dedikna, usevar appe deattik yomin, attika deattikin. zakkaa chulakach, vezakkaa chulaki immechon bealma deate.
Tikkuna tinyayna. mittakan saara, meresha defuma, ad resha achara defuma, betikkuna shakil.

Kum ribbi chizkiyya, vekaim bekiyyumach, veokir yekara detikkuna da dedikna kaddisha. kam ribbi chizkiyya, share veamar, (Shir HaShirim 7:11) ani ledodi vealay teshukato mi garam sheani ledodi. mishshum dealay teshukato.

Mistakkel havina, vaaru chamit, nehora yakkira devutzina illaa, nahir vesalik litlat mea vachamishsha veesrin ivar. vechad chashoch hava itsache behahu nehora, keman deitseche behahu nahara amika, dememoy mitpallegin, unehirin, venagdin lechol ivar, mimma dealoy. vesalik hahu nehora, bisfata deyamma illaa amika, dechol pitchin tavin veyakkirin, behahu pitcha itpattechan.

Ana shail mehem (sefer acher mahu), pishra dechamet. patchu veamru, nose avon chameta. amar, da hu tikkuna tinyayna. yativ. amar ribbi shimon, haidana itkashshar (sefer acher itbesam) alma. berich ant ribbi chizkiyya, leattika deattikin.

Amar rabbi shimon, kullehu butzinin chavrin, deatyayn behay izka kaddisha. ashadna alay shemayay ilain deillain, veara kaddisha illaa deillaa. daana chame hasheta, ma dela chama bar nash, miyyoma desalik moshe zimna tinyayna letura desinay. daana chamena anpai nehirin, kinhora deshimsha takkifa, dezammin lemeppak beasvavta lealma. dichtiv, (Malachi 3:20) vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha. veod daana yedana deanpay nehirin, umoshe la yada vela istakkal. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 34:29) umoshe la yada ki karan or panav.

Veod, daana chame beenay, telesar mechilin gelifin kammay, unehirin kevutzinin. vechad itperish kol chad minnayyhu mippumechon, istalik veittekan, veitattar veittammar bitmiruta detikkune dedikna, vechol acharanin ishtaaran. uveod dechol chad mitperash befumayychu, nahir veitattar veyativ kemalka bego cheleh. vechad isteyaym leitparsha, salik veitattar beitra kaddisha, veittakkan veittammar, veyativ betikkunoy dedikna kaddisha, vechen lechol chad vechad. izderazu chavrin kaddishin, deha bekiyyuma da, la yehe ad deyete malka meshicha.

Kum ribbi chizkiyya tinyaynut. veokir tikuna telitaa, dedikna kaddisha. tana, ad la kam ribbi chizkiyya, kala nafak veamar, en malach echad ose shete shelichut. itregish rabbi shimon veamar, vadday kol chad vechad beatreh. vaana, veribbi elazar beri, veribbi abba, ishtelim shelemata illaa.

Kum ribbi chiyay. kam ribbi chiyyay, patach veamar, (Yirmeyahu 1:6) vaomar ahah Adonai elohim hinne la yadati dabber ki naar anochi. vechi yirmiyya la hava yada lemallela, veha kama milulin nafke mippumoy, ad la amar da. vehu amar milla kediva, dichtiv hinne lo yadati dabber. ella (tana) chas veshalom deihu amar al da. ella hachi tana, ma ben dibbur laamira. amira hu dela bae learma kala,
1296: Dibbur, bae learma kala, uleachreza millin.

Dichtiv, (Shemot 20:1) vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle lemor. vetana, kol alma shamu hahu dibbur, vechol alma izdaazau. uvegin kach ketiv vaydabber, vela ketiv vayyomer. uf hacha ketiv hinne lo yadati dabber, leachreza milla uleochacha beruach kudsha lealma.

I hachi, ha ketiv (Shemot 6:10) vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor. ella, man hu nevia illaa kemoshe, dela zacha bar nash kevavteh. dehu shama dibbur behacheraza, vela dachil, vela izdaza. ushear neviim izdaazau, afillu baamira, vedachalin bidchilu.

Vetana, tikkuna kadmaa dedikna, vetinyayna leatava (sefer acher leayytaa) (sefer acher laakapea) litlitaa. dichtiv, (Iyov 33:29) hen kol elle yifal el faamayim shalosh im gaver. (teren navesachey) veta chaze ditren tikkunin kadmain lemete letlitaa havu dehu tikkuna telitaa. meemtzaita ditchot chotama, mittechot teren nukevin. nafik chad archa, vesaara afsik (sefer acher atepasek) behahu archa. amay itpesak. mishshum (dichtiv veover al pesha) dehay orcha ittakkan leabera beh. uvegin kach, yetiv techot nukeve chotama hay orcha. vesaara la itrabbe behay orcha, mishshum dichtiv veover al pesha, lemehav abera ad (al) puma kaddisha, deyemma salachti. tana, kama arkisaot mechakkan lehahu puma, vela itgele lechad minnayyhu, deha istellak veitattar, yedia vela yedia. tana, bitzniuta desifra, mahu dichtiv pesha. zachu over, lo zachu pesha. (may mashma over al pesha, shefa deakdim 300 110, lo zachu omed velo over) (hay) bizer appin.

May ben hay lehay. bizer appin, kad nachit hahu orcha mittechot nukeve chotamoy, ketiv, (Bamidbar 12:9) vayyichar af Adonai bam vayyelach. may vayyelach. denafik rucha derugeza meinnun nukeve, uman deashkach kammeh, azil vela ishtechach. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:7) ki ruach Adonai nashva bo veenennu (sefer acher ki ruach avera bo veenennu). bearich appin ketiv, (Micha 7:18) veover al pesha. uchetiv, (Iyov 37:21) veruach avra vattetaharem. vetana, hacha ketiv, over al pesha behahu archa. hatam, (Shemot 12:23) veavar Adonai lingof et mitzrayim.

Zakkaa chulakeh deman dezache lehay. veda hu tikkuna telitaa, (deorcha) dedikna yakkira kaddisha illaa attika deattike. amar rabbi shimon, vadday kudesha berich hu yasge leotava lach, veyechde leaggana alach.

Vetana, may dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 61:10) sos asis baAdonai, beattik yomin ittemar. deha hu chedvavta decholla. tana, beshaata deitgele hay orcha dedikna deattik yomin. kullehu mare divava vilala, umarehon dedina setimin ushetikin, velet deyiftach pitra leavasha. mishshum dehay orcha itgalyay letakkena. umehay, man deachid (nusach acher daachayt) veazhar (mishshum dehay orcha simana lishtikuta umehay hu man deachze veazhar) leshatkaa, lehay orcha reshim, dehu simana deattika kadisha.

Tikkuna reviaa, mittakan saara (venachit) techot puma, meresha chada leresha chada. hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:18) lisherit nachalato. kema deat amer (Melachim 2 19:4) venasata tefilla bead hashsheerit hannimtzaa. hannimtzaa mammash. sheerit dichtiv, (Tzefanya 3:13) sheerit yisrael lo yaasu avla.

Tikkuna chamishshaa. nafik orcha achara mittechot puma, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:18) lo hechezik laad appo. kum ribbi yose. kam ribbi yose, patach veamar, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elohav. ashre haam shekkacha lo. mahu shekkacha lo. kema deat amer (Ester 7:10) vachamat hammelech shachacha, shachich merugeze.
Davar acher. shachich berugezeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 11:15) veim kacha at ose li hargeni na harog. da hu dina dedina. ashre haam sheAdonai elohav, rachame derachame.
Davar acher, shekkacha, shema dechalil kol shemahan, vekudesha berich hu mabar rugezeh, vaanach beh lizer anpin, umaavir al kol innun dilvar.
Detanya, archa, illaa dedikna kaddisha, (illaa attika daataykay) deihu nachit (badeykenayh) techot nukeve dechotama deattike. vehay archa diltatta. shekilan innun becholla. da
1297: Leella, veda letatta. leella, over al pesha. letatta, lo hechezik laad appo. vetanenan, lo hechozik: dela it atar lemetav. kema dilella yahiv atra leabera. kach letatta, yahiv atar leabera.

Tana, bechol atar divhay attika temira decholla archa itgalyay, tav lechullehu diltatta, deha itchaze eta lemebad tav lecholla. man desatim vela itgalyay, let eta, velet man deyeda leh, ella hu bilchodoy. kema deeden illaa, let deyeda leh ella hu attika deattike. veal hay ketiv, (Tehillim 92:6) ma gadlu maasecha Adonai meod amku machshevotecha. amar rabbi shimon yittakkenun ovadach lealma deate. meim attika deattikin.
Tikkuna shetitaa. mittaken saara vesalik millera leella, vechafe takruveta devusema tava ad resha defuma dilella. venachit saara (deresha) leresha defitcha dearcha tattaa defuma.
Kum ribbi yesa veatkin tikkuna da. kam ribbi yesa, patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 54:10) vechasdi meittech lo yamush, uchetiv (Yeshayahu 54:8) uvechesed olam richamtich, hane kerae kashyayn ahadde.

Vela akshu, detanenan, it chesed veit chesed. it chesed dilgo, veit chesed dilvar. chesed dilgo, ha deamaran deattika deattikin, vehu satim besitra da dedikna, deikre peat hazzakan. vela bae bar nash lechabbela hay sitra, mishshum hay chesed dilgo deattik yomin. uvegin kach, bechohen diltatta ketiv beh, (Vayikra 21:5) lo yikrechu karcha berosham ufeat zekanam lo yegalechu. may tama. begin dela lechabbela orchoy dechesed deattika, dechohen missitra da ka ate.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, becholla itzterich chesed leitrabbea ulemivne, vela lekata leh, vela ishtetze mealma. vehay dichtiv vechasdi meittech lo yamush, chesed deattik yomin. uvechesed olam, chesed deikre chesed olam, vehay hu achara dizer anpin, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:3) amarti olam chesed yibbane.

Vehay chesed deattik deattikin, hu chesed dikshot. vechesed dikshot lav bechayye gufa ittemar, ella bechayye denishmeta. uvegin kach ketiv, (Micha 7:18) ki chafetz chesed hu. da hu tikkuna shetitaa dedikna yakkira, deattik deattike.
Tikkuna sheviaa. pasik saara, veitchazn 2 tappuchin betikruveta devusema, shappiran veyaan lemechoze.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:3) ketappuach baatze hayyaar vegomer. ma tappuach ze kalil bitlat gevavne, kach kudesha berich hu, teren tappuchin kalil shitta gevavne, uteren tappuchin illen, deinnun tikkuna 7, innun kelala dechol shita tikkunin daamena. uveginehon itkayyaym (Mishlei 16:15) beor pene melech chayyim.

Vetana, mehane tappuchin nafkin chayyin lealma, umechazyayn chedu lizer appin. ketiv (Bamidbar 6:25) yaer Adonai panav elecha. uchetiv (Mishlei 16:15) beor pene melech chayyim. beor pene melech illen innun teren tappuchin detikrovta devusema daamena. yaer Adonai panav elecha, panim dilvar, dechad nehirin mitbarech alma.
Vetana, kol zeman dehane botzine dilvar nehirin, kol alma mitbarech, vela ishtechach rugeza bealma. uma i hane dilvar kach. teren tappuchin dinhirin tedira, dechaddan tedira al achat kamma vechamma.

Tanya, kad itgalleyayn teren tappuchin illen, itchaze zeer appin bechedvavta. vechol innun butzinin diltatta, bechedvavta. vechol innun diltatta, nehirin, vechol almin chaddan, ushelemin mikkol shelemuta. vecholla chaddan unehirin. vechol tivu la pasik. kullehu itmalleyayn beshaata chada, kullehu chaddan beshaata chada.

Ta chaze, panim dilvar, it zeman dinhirin, veit zeman dela nehirin. uvegin kach ketiv, yaer Adonai panav elecha. (Tehillim 67:2) yaer panav ittanu sela. michlal dela havi tedira. ella kad itgalleyayn tappuchin dilella.

Tana, illen tappuchin distimin, nehirin vechivvavrin tedira. uminnehon nehirin litlat mea veshivin ivar. vechol shita tikkunin kadmain divdikna beh kelilan. hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:19) yashuv yerachamenu. yashuv, michlal dezimnin temirin, vezimnin itgalleyayn. hacha, hu yashuv yerachamenu. uvehay diltatta, hu veemet. da hu tikkuna
1298: Sheviaa, dechalil shita, bitren tappuchin divattika deattikin.
Tikkuna teminaa. nafik chad chuta desare socharaneh dedikna, vetalyayn beshikkula ad tabbura. kum elazar beri, atkin tikkuna da.

Kam ribbi elazar (bereh), patach veamar, hakkol taluy bemazzal, vaafillu sefer tora bahechol. milla da okimna besifra ditzniuta, vehacha it leistakkela, vechi hakkol taluy bemazzal, vetanenan, sefer tora kodesh, venarteko kodesh, vehahechol kodesh. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 6:3) vekara ze el ze veamar kadosh kadosh kadosh, ha telat innun. vesefer tora. lokovlehon, narteko kodesh, vehahechol kodesh, vehu kadosh. vehattora nittena beg kedushot. beshalosh maalot, beyyamim shelosha, shechina beshalosh, luchot vaaron vehechal besefer tora talya, veihu talya bemazzal, uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 10:2) umeotot hashshamayim al techattu. man deihu bikdushot hallalu leheve talya bemazzala.

Ella hachi okimna besifra ditzniuta, hay chuta yakkira kaddisha, dechol sare dedikna talyayn beh, itkere mazzal. may tama. mishshum dechol kadshe kodashin dekudeshayya, behay mazzala talyayn. vesefer tora, af al gav deihu kadosh la chal aleh eser kidushin ad deayil lahechol. kevan deayil lahechol, itkere kadosh beeser kedushot. kegavvna da dela itkere hechol, ella kad itchabberan eser kedushot. vetana, hakkol taluy bemazzal, deihu hay chuta yakkira kadisha, dechol saarin talyayn beh.

Amay ikre mazzal. mishshum deminneh talyayn mazzale, umazzele minneh illain vetattain. uvegin kach ihi talyay. uveh talyayn kol mille dealma illain vetattain. vaafillu sefer tora shebbahechol, demitatter beeser kedushot, la nafik mikkelaleh im shear kiddushin vechullehu talyayn behay. uman dechame lehay tikkuna, ittekabbeshan chovehon mikkammeh umitkafyayn, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:19) yichbosh avonotenu. amar leh rabbi shimon, berich beri lekudesha dekaddishin, attik mikkolla.

Tikkuna teshiaa. mitarvin sare im innun sare detalyayn, vela nafkin da min da. kum ribbi abba, kam ribbi abba veamar, illen (inun) sare demitarvin im innun detalyayn, ikrun metzulot yam. mishshum denafke mimmotre mocha, umehay atra remiu, kol mare detavin chove divne nasha umitkafyayn. amar rabbi shimon, berich tehe leattik yomin.

Tikkuna ashiraa. nachtin sare techot dikna, vechappeyayn bigrona techot dikna. kum ribbi yehuda. kam ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 2:19) uvau bimarot tzurim uvimchillot afar mippene pachad Adonai vegomer. mippene pachad Adonai, ha ityeda deman deihu levar, pachad Adonai itkere. umehadar geono, innun sare ditchot dikna, veitkerun hadar geono, tere. tikkuna asiraa, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. vechad sar, dela nafke nima min nima, chesed leavraham.
Tikkuna ditresar. dela talyayn sare al puma, ufuma itpene mikkol sitrin, veyain sare sechor sechor leh, begin dela ishtechach tarchuta, kema deitzterich.

Tarchuta bemay ka mayyre. dina. baatar (nusach acher batar) dina tarchuta ishtechach. vechi sare dedikna tircha innun, o dina innun, veha kolla rachame itchazun. ella dela itterach beyishshuva (sefer acher baneshavebaa) derucha dizer appin.

Detana mehay puma kaddisha illaa, kodesh kodashim, nashva rucha. may rucha. rucha deitterak (sefer acher deitdabbak) beh, demitlebash beh (nusach acher deittakkan umitlabbesh beh) zeer appin. umehay rucha mitlabbeshin kol innun diltatta. vechad hahu rucha nafik, itperash litllatin veshiva elef ivar. veitpashshat (sefer acher vaataperashea) kol chad bilchodoy leatreh, vechol man deitchaze leitlabbesha minneh itlabbash. veal da saarin la ishtechachu al puma kaddisha, mishshum derucheh nafik, vela bae milla achara leitarva beh, ulekarva bahadeh.
Veda hu temiruta decholla, dela itdevak la leella vela letatta. vehu satim bistima distimin dela ityeda.
1299: Da hu dela ittakkan, vela hava beh tikkuna. uvegin kach, ruach denafik levar (sefer acher denafik mehahu dilvar), umitlabbeshin beh nevie mehemne, itkere pe Adonai. aval behay attika deattikin la itperash. velet man deyeda rucheh bar ihu. uvegin kach saaroy shekilin sucharane defuma, ufuma itpene mikkol sitroy.

Uvehay itrechitzu avhatana, leitlabbesha behay rucha, demitpashat lechamma ivarin, baatar dechol sare shekilin besocharanoy. (hada hu dichtiv, 0 asher nishbata laavotenu). veda hu tikkuna kaddisha illaa ditresar. demikkan ishtelshalu 12 techumin leella. 12 techumin letatta. 12 techumin 42 shivte avahata. hada hu dichtiv asher nishbata laavotenu.
Tikkuna ditlesar. talyayn sare ditchot dikna mikkan umikkan, bikara yaa, uvikara shappira, vechappeyayn ad tabbura vela itchazyayn meanpe takruva devusema, bar innun tappuchin shappiran chivvavrin.

Amar ribbi shimon, zakkaa chulakeh deman deishtechach behay iddara kaddisha illaa daanan beh. zakkaa chulakeh bealma den, uvealma deate. daanan yatvin bikdusha illaa, eshsha illaa aschar lan (sefer acher ben eshsha illaa deaschar lan) veha kol tikkunin illain (lediyyukena) dedikna kaddisha ittakanu, veitatteru veascharu leduchetayyhu.

Vehay tikkuna ditlesar, hu tikkuna yae, deveh achidan kolla. kullehu mitkassefin lemizkaf resha lokovleh. minneh talyayn kol innun devizer appin achidan. minneh talyayn illain vetattain, vechol ginzin illain vetattain genizin beh, uveh kelilan. veihu mazzala demitzala minneh kolla, da hu tikkuna shelemata, deashlim lechol tikkunin, da ashlim lecholla.

Tana, illen tikkunin ikrun yeme kedem, yomin kadmain dekadmae. veinnun deishtechachu bizer appin, ikrun (Yeshayahu 63:9) yeme olam. vetana, illen yeme kedem, kullehu mittaknan betikkuna dedikna deattika deattikin, temira ditmirin (kalil behu). vehay ditlesar kalil lehon, kema deittemar. veda yoma la itkelil bahadayyhu, ella hu kalil kolla.

Uvehahu zimna deittear attik yomin betikunin dilella, hahu itkere yom echad, deveh zammin leokir dikneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:7) yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai. hu bilchodoy yattir mikkolla. hu dechalil kolla, hu deitkere bishma yedia.

Detanenan, baatar deit yom it layla delet yom bela layla. umishshum dehahu zimna, zeman yehe diykara dedikna, vehu bilchodoy yishtekach. la itkere la yom vela layla. delet yom ikre, ella missitra dilan. velet layla ikre, ella missitra dilan. umishshum dehay tikkuna kalil kolla, la ityeda vela itchaze minneh, uminneh nagid mishcha dirvuta litlesar ivar mabbuin. lechol innun diltatta, dinhirin behahu mishcha. (ittekanu)

Bitlesar tikkunin illen ittakna dikna kaddisha illaa, veillen tikkunin divhay dikna, mittakkenan venachtan lechamma ivar. vela itchazun hech mitpashshetin vehech nafkin, mikkolla astimu, umikkolla ittamaru. let deyada atar lehay attika, bifshituta dilhon kullehon kelilan, kema deittemar, ityeda vela ityeda. tamir vela tamir. aleh itkere, (Yeshayahu 42:8) ani Adonai hu shemi uchevodi leacher lo etten. uchetiv (tehillim 100) hu asanu velo anachnu. uchetiv (Daniel 7:9) veattik yomin yetiv. beatreh yetiv velet yedia leh. yetiv vela shechiach, uchetiv (Tehillim 139:14) odcha al ki noraot nifleti vegomer.

Amar rabbi shimon lechavrayyay, kad itperis perisa da, deattun chaman alana, ana chamena denachtu kol tikkunin begavvav, unehiru beatar da. vechad parochta butzina dekudesha (sefer acher bavesaytaa dikdushsha) berich hu, perisa bearba samchin, learba ivar.
1300: Samcha chad hu yativ mittatta leella, vechad magrofya bideh. uvemagrofya arba maftechi sheninan (sefer acher shanyayn) mikkol sitroy. umitachadan parsa, venachtin lah meella letatta. vechen lesamcha tinyayna, utelitaa ureviaa. uven samcha lesamcha, achidan timnesar ragle desamchi umitnaharin bevutzina diglifa (babevaseytea dagelaypayn) behahu perisa. vechen led ivar.

Vachamena illen tikkunin dinhirin alah, vahavu mechakkan mille defumana, leitattera uleistalleka kol chad beatreh. vechad havo mittakkenan mippumana, kol chad vechad salik veitattar veittakkan behahu tikkuna deittekan hacha, mikkol (sefer acher behevel dechol) puma dechad minan. uveshaata dechad minan patach puma, letakkena behahu tikkuna, hahu tikkuna hava yetiv umechakke lemilla denafik mippumechon, ucheden salleka beducheteh veitattar.

Vechol samchin mikkan umikkan, chaddan al deshamin ma dela yadu, vetzayytin lekallechon. kama retichin kayymin hacha beginechon. zakkain attun lealma deate, dechullehu mille denafke mippumechon, kullehu millin kaddishin. millin kashran dela astan limina velismala.

Kudesha berich hu chadde lemishma, vetzayit lehane mille, ad dehu agmar (sefer acher agezar) dina, di lealma deate temrun zimna achara kol hane mille kaddishin. alayychu ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:10) vechikkech keyen hattov vegomer, dovev sifte yeshenim. may dovev sefatay yeshenim. deafillu lealma deate merachshan sifvavtaychu orayyta kammeh.

Hasheta ittakanu veitkavvnu data, lemitkan tikkunoy dizer appin, hech yittakkan, vehech yitlabbash betikkunoy mitikkune attik yomin, kaddisha dekaddishin, temira ditmirin, temira mikkolla. dehashta chovata (chachmeta) alayychu, lemigzar dina kushetaa yae veshappira uleatkena kol tikkunin al bureyeh.

Tikkune dizer appin, mittikune daarich appin ittakkanu. veitpashatu tikkunoy mikkan umikkan, kechezu bar nash, lemishleta (sefer acher vameshalechaa) beh rucha ditmira dechol temirin. begin lemetav al kuresyyay, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav milmala. kemare adam: dechalil kol diukenin. kemare adam: dechalil kol shemahan. kemare adam: deveh setimin kol almin illain vetattain. kemare adam: dechalil kol razin deitammaru veittatkanu ad dela ivre alma, veaf al gav dela itkayyaymu.

Tana bitzniuta desifra, attika deattikin ad la zammin tikkunoy, bane malchin, kanes malchin, (nusach acher 0 galif malchin) umeshaer malchin, vela havo mitkayyeymme, ad dedache (sefer acher deanach) lon, veatzna lon levatar zimna, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:31) veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom. beeretz edom, beatar dechol dinin mitkayyeymin tamman, vechullehu la itkayyaymu.

Ad deresha chivvavra attika deattikin ittakkan. kad ittakkan, takkin kol tikkunin diltatta, takkin kol tikkunin deillain vetattain. mikkan olifna, kol resha deamma, dela ittakkan hu bekadmita, let amma mittakna. vei ihu mittakkan, kullehu mittakkenan. vei ihu la mittakken bekadmita, la yachlin amma leittakkena.

Menalan. meattik yomin. dead la ittakkan hu betikkunoy, la ittekkanu kol innun devau leittakkena, vechullehu almin itcharavu. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:32) vayyimloch beedom bela ben beor. vayyimloch beedom, raza chada (sefer acher yakkira) hu. atar dechol dinin mitkatterin tamman, vetalyayn, mittamman.

Bela ben beor, tana hu gizrat dina, takkifa detakkifin, divgineh mitkatteran elef alfin mare divava vilala. (Bereshit 36:32) veshem iro dinhava. may dinhava. kelomar din hava. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 20) laaluka shete banot hav hav.
Kevan desalik leityashsheva, beh la kaim, vela hava yachil lemekam, vechullehu almin itcharavu. may taama. mishshum deadam la ittakkan. detikkuna deadam bediukeneh, kalil kolla, veyachil
1301: Uvegin detikkuna da deadam, la ishtechach. la yachilu lemekam uleityashsheva, veitbetalu. veitbetalu salleka datach veha kullehu beadam itkelilan. ella itbetalu veistallaku mehahu tikkuna, ad deyete tikkuna (nusach acher diyyukena) deadam. vechad ata hay diyyukena, itgelafu (sefer acher itkelalu) kullehu, veitchazzaru lekiyyuma achara. minnehon itbesamu, (sefer acher minnehon itbessamu velo itbessamu) uminnehon la itbesamu kelal.

Vei tema veha ketiv vayyamat, vayyamat. deitbetalu legamre. lav hachi, ella kol man denachit middarga kadmaa dehava beh, kare beh mita. kema deat amer, (Shemot 2:23) vayyamat melech mitzrayim, denachat middarga kadmaa dehava kam beh. vechevan deittakan adam, itkerun bishmahan acharanin, veitbesamu bekiyyuma beh, vekayymin beduchetayyhu.

Vechullehu itkerun bishmahan acharanin min kadmain, bar hahu dichtiv beh, (Bereshit 36:39) veshem ishto mehetavel bat matred bat me zahav. may tama. mishshum dehane la itbetalu kishar acharanin. mishshum dehava dechar venukeba. kehay temara, dela salleka ella dechar venukeba. uvegin kach hasheta deishtechachu dechar venukeba, la ketiv behu mita keacharanin, veitkeyaymu. aval la ityashavu, ad deittekan diyyukena deadam, vechevan deittekan diyyukena deadam, itchazaru veitkeyaymu bekiyyuma achara, veityeyshavu.

Tana, kad salik biruta deresha chivvavra, lemebad yekara likareh, takkin vezammin veappik mibbutzina dekardinuta, chad nitzotza, nashav beh ittokkar (sefer acher ittakkan) vesalik (reuteh) veitpashshat litlat mea veshivin ivar. venitzotza kaim, veshari nafik avira dachya umitgalgela, nashav beh ittakkan. venafik chad gulegalta takkifa, veitpashshat learba sitrin.

Uvehay avira dachya, ishteiv nitzotza veitachad, vechalil (sefer acher veitkelil) beh. beh salleka datach. ella ittamar beh. uvegin kach, hay gulegalta itpashat besitroy, vehay avira hu tamir ditmirin deattik yomin, berucha deganiz.

Behay gulegalta itpashatu eshsha missetar chad, vaavira missetar chad. vaavira dachya kaim aleh mehay setar. veeshsha dachya kaim mehay setar. may eshsha hacha. ella lav hu eshsha, aval butzina da (nusach acher naytzavetzaa) deitkelil baavira dachya, nahir lematan veshivin almin, vedina missitroy ishtechach, uvegin da, hay gulegalta, itkere gulegalta takkifa.

Begulegalta da, yatvin tisha alfe ribbo almin, denatlin aloy vesamchin aloy. behay gulegalta, natif talla meresha chivvavra, deitmelle mineh tadir. umehay talla deanar meresheh zeminin metayyay leachayyaa.

Vehu talla deitkelil bitre gevavne, missitra deresha chivvara, chivvavr begavivy (sefer acher begineh). dechalil kullehu chivvavre (vechullehu chayvaveray) aval kad ityayshshevan behay resha dizer appin, itchaze beh sumaka. kehay bedolcha deihu chivvavr, veitchazyay gavvna sumaka begavvna chivvavra.

Uvegin kach ketiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim miyyeshene admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot lediron olam. lechayye olam, begin deitchaziu lehahu chivvavra, deate mistar deattik yomin, aricha deanpin. lacharafot lediron olam, begin deitchaziu lehahu sumaka dizer appin. vecholla kalil behahu talla, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) ki tal orot tallecha. orot: teren. vehahu talla denatif, natif kol yoma lechakla detappuchim. kegvavne chivvavra vesumaka.

Hay gulegalta anhir bitre gevavne, lehay setar ulehay setar. umehay avira dachya, itpashat megulegalta leanpoy 150 ribbo almin. uvegin kach itkere zeer appin. uveshaata deitzterich, itpeshatu anpoy vaarichin behahu zimna, begin deashgach beanpoy deattike deattikin, vechayes lealma.
Umehay gulegalta, nafik chad ivar, lechol innun diltatta. veyahave agar orauta leattik yomin. kad alin bechushebana,
1302: Techot sharvita. velokovel da. (Shemot 38:26) beka lagulegolet letatta, kad alin bechushebana. vehay beka agar orauta, ishtechach minneh leattik yomin.

Bachallaleh degulegalta, (sefer acher begulegalta da) 3 chalallin ishtechachu, desharyay mocha behu, ukeruma dakik chafyyay alayyhu. aval la keruma keshisha setima keattik yomin. uvegin da, hay mocha itpeshat venahir (sefer acher venafik) litllatin uteren shevilin. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden.

Vetana, bitlat chalalin degulegalta mocha sharyay. mechalala chad mitbeka (sefer acher umitpashshet) chad mabbua led sitrin, venafik mehahu mocha desharyay behay challala, telatin uteren shevilin ruchin dechachmeta.

Mechalala tinyayna, mitbeka umitpashat chad mabbua achara. umitpatchin 50 tarin. meillen 50 tarin, itachadan 50 yomin deorayyta. 50 shenin deyovla. 50 elef darin, dezammin kudesha berich hu leatava rucheh leh, ulesharyay beh.

Mechalala telitaa, nafkin elef alfin iddarin veachsadrain, dedata sharyay alayyhu, vedare behu. vehay challala share chalale (sefer acher medoreh) ben hay challala uven hay challala, veitmalleyayn mitteren sitrin. kol innun iddarin. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:4) uvedaat chadarim yimmalu. veillen 3 mitpashshetin bechol gufa, lehay sitra ulehay sitra. uveinnun achid kol gufa veachid behu gufa mikkol sitroy. uvechol gufa itpashshetan veishtakkechan.

Tana, begulegalta deresha, talyayn elef alfe ribbo veribbo ribbevan kotze desare uchaman, umistabbechin da beda, umitarvin da beda. velet chushebana lenimin dechol kotza vekotza, daachidan beh dachyayn umesaavan. umikkan itachadan taame orayyta, bedachya bimsaava. bechol innun sitrin deinnun dachyayn, vechol innun sitrin deinnun misavan.

Yatvin kotze mistabbechin vetakifin. minnehon sheiin, uminhon takkifin. uvechol kotza vekotza, yatvin nimin tilin al tilin. mitlahatan vetalyayn kegibbar takkif, mare natzach keravin. betikkuna yae betikkuna shappira takkifa (bachur kaarazim). ravrevin vetakifin. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) bachur kaarazim.

Mittakkenin kotzin desare, vetalyayn tilin al tilin, mehay sitra lehay sitra, al gulegolta. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:11) kevutztzotav taltallim. vetana yatvin tile tillin, mishshum dimshichin mimmabbuin saggiin, ditlat rahate mocha. mimmabbua challala chad degulegalta, itmashshechan sare bimshichuta, umitavdin tilin, detalyayn mikkamma mabbuin, deitmashshechan mehay challala. mechalala tinyayna, nafke chamshin mabbuin, veitmashshechan sare meinnun mabbuin bimshichuta, veitavdin tilin, detalyayn umitarvin bekotzin acharanin. mechalala telitaa, nafke elef alfin iddarin veachsadrain, veitmashshechan sare bimshichuta mikkullehu. (vametaabadeyn talin al talin umitarvin bakevatzeyn acharanin) uvegin kach innun kotzin, tillin al tillin.

Vechullehu meshichan deitmashshechan mig chalalin democha degulegalta. vechol innun nimin vechol innun kotze talyayn vechappeyayn lesitra deudenin. uvegin kach ketiv, (Daniel 9:18) hatte elohay aznecha ushema. uvehay tilin, talyayn (nusach acher uvehay talyayn) yemina usemala, nehora vachashocha, rachame vedina. vechol yemina usemala tale behay, vela beattika.

Befalguta desare, itchaze chad orcha dakik, demitachada mehahu archa deattik yomin. umehahu archa, itparshan shit mea utelesar archin, deitpalgun bearchin defikude deorayyta. dichtiv, (Tehillim 25:10) kol archot Adonai chesed veemet lenotzre verito veedotav.

Tana, bechol kotza vekotza, mitachadan elef alfin mare divava vilala, detalyayn vechol kotza vekotza meinnun takkifin. umeinnun sheiin marehon dematkela, (sefer acher marehon dirchimuta veihu matkela benayyhu) begin kach it yemina veit semala.

Mitzcha degulegalta. ashgachuta deashgachuta. vela mitgalyay, bar hahu zimna, ditzrichin chayyayvayya leitpakkeda, uleayyeyna beovadehon. vetana, kad itgalyay hay mitzcha, ittearu kol marehon dedina, vechol alma bedina itmesar.
1303: Bar hahi shaata, kad seliku tzelothon deyisrael lekamme attik yomin, uvae lerachama al benoy, galle mitzcha deraava deraavin, venahir behay dizer appin, veishtechich dina.

Behay mitzcha, nafik chad (pikkude 237 amud bet) saara, demitpeshat beh mimmocha deappik chamshin tarin. vechad itpeshat, itavid mitzcha deashgachuta, lechayyayve alma, leinnun dela mitkassefe beovadehon. hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 3:3) umetzach ishsha zona haya lach meant hikkalem.

Vetanya, saara la kaim behay atar demitzcha, begin deitgalyay leinnun dechatztzifin bechovayyhu. veshaata demittear kudesha berich hu leishtashea im tzaddikayyay, nehirin anpohi deattik yomin, beanpoy dizer appin, umitgalya mitzcheh, venahir lehay mitzcha, ucheden itkere et ratzon. vechol shaata veshaata dedina tale, vehay mitzcha dizer appin itgalyay, itgalyay mitzcha deattika deattikin, veishtechich dina, vela itavid.

Tana, hay mitzcha, itpashat bematan elef sumake desumake, deitachadan beh, uchelilan beh. vechad itgalyay mitzcha dizer appin, it reshuta lechullehu lecharabba. vechad itgalyay mitzcha deraava deraavin, denahir lehay mitzcha, keden kullehu mishtachchin. (129, 233)

Vetanya, esrin vearba batte dinin mishtakkechin behay mitzcha, vechullehu ikrun netzach (sefer acher mitzcha vechol chad ikre netzach). uveatvavn (daapayn) retzufin, hu metzach. veit netzach deinnun netzachim. vehayeynu ditnan netzach netzachim. veinnun bemitzcha, umitpashshetan minnehon begufa, beatrin yedian.

Tanya, may dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 15:29) vegam netzach yisrael lo yeshakker velo yinnachem ki lo adam hu lehinnachem. hay raza okimna, kol hahu netzach deitpeshat begufa, zimnin detale al alma lemedan, vetav umitcharet vela avid dina, i tayyvin. may tama. mishshum dekae beducheta deikre adam, veyachil leitcharta. aval i beatar deitkere rosh, (behay mitzcha) itchaze veitgalyay hay netzach, lav hu iddan vaatar leitcharta. may tama. mishshum dela hava meatar deikre adam, deha la itgele partzufa vechotama, ella mitzcha bilchodoy. uvaatar dela ishtechach partzufa, la ikre adam. uvegin kach lo adam hu lehinnachem kenetzach devishar tikkune gufa.

Enoy deresha, mishtanyayn mishshear ayynin, serikuta divgavta, deal rise ayynin, mekachalan (dechol ayynin makechalen) beukkamuta, talyayn tillin al tillin desare, veinnun tikkuna deal ayynin, beresha demitzcha, umitachadan mittarvavyyhu sheva mea alfe mare deashgachuta. (deal terise deayynin)

Bichsuta deayynin, lahatin elef vearba mea ribbo, demitachadan bigvinin deinhu kesuta. veashgachuta deena deattik yomin alayyhu. uveshaata desallekin innun kesuta, itchaze keman deittear mishshenateh, veitpakkechan enoy, vechaman leena pekicha, veitsachan bechad chivvavra deena tava, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:12) rochatzot bechalav. may bechalav. bechivvavra dilella kadmaa (nusach acher bechivvavra kadmaa deena tava). uvehahi shaata ishtechach ashgachuta derachame. (sefer acher uvegin kach tzelota deyisrael salleka begin daypakech enoy, vaytasechaven behahu chivvavra)

Veal da tzalle david, (Tehillim 44:24) ura lamma tishan Adonai hakitza. deyifkach enoy, veyitsachun behahu chivvavra. vechol zimna deenoy lav mitpakchan, kol marehon dedinin, kafyayn lehu leyisrael, ushear ammin shaltin alayyhu. uvezimna deyifkach enoy, yitsachan beena tava, verachame al yisrael. veistechar (sefer acher vaatazehar) ena, veavid nukemin bishar ammin. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 35:23) haira vehakitza. haira: leitsachaa behahi chivvavra. hakitza: lemebad nukemin leinnun dechafyayn lon.
Enoy kad itpakchan, itchazun shappirin kehane yonim, besumak veucham veyarok, chivvavr la itgele, ella bezimna deistakkal beena tava, umistechan kol innun gavvnin, behahu chivvavr.
Meinnun gavvnin demitgalleyayn, nafkin shiva ayynin deashgachuta. denafke meuchama
1304: Deena. hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 3:9) al even achat shiva enayim. man even achat. uchamuta deena.

Missumaka, nafkin shiva rehitin, desamchin (nusach acher desacharan) listar semala, umitlahatin beeshsha delistar tzafon, umitachadan leitpashsheta bealma, legallaa archin dechayayvayya hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 4:10) shiva (vaychi 249) elle ene Adonai hemma meshottim bechol haaretz.

Miroka, nafkin shiva tehirin (sefer acher nehirin) dekitra delistar (nusach acher rehitin desacharan listar) daroma, umitachadan leitpashsheta bealma, legallaa archin veovadin divne nasha, ben tav ben bish, dichtiv, (Iyov 34:21) ki enav al darche ish vegomer.

Vechad istechan bechivvavra, mishtakkechin kullehu leashgacha lechol mare keshot, leotava alma beginehon. vechol ashgachuta dehahu chivvavra, havi letav al yisrael. veashgach besumaka leman deakin lehu. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 3:7) rao raiti. rao: leotava lon. raiti: lenakma lon, middeakin lon, uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 44:24) ura lamma tishan Adonai hakitza al tiznach lanetzach. ura, vehakitza, tere ashgachuta. tere pekichin. tere tavan. rachame venukemin.
Gavvna kadmaa, sumaka bego sumaka kalil vesatim kol sumakin, mikkameh la itchazun. socharaneh dehahu sumaka, aschar chad chuta uchama, veakif leh.

Gavvna tinyayna, uchama. keavna chad denafik mittehoma, chad zeman leelef shanim, beyamma rabba. vechad nafik hay avna, ate riggesha vetukfa al yamma. vekaleh deyamma, vegalgallohi azlin, veishtamu lenuna rabba, deikre livyatan. venafik mittehoma. vehay avna mitgalgela betukefa deyamma, venafik levar. vehi uchama, dechol uchamin setimin kameh. (sefer acher veha ukemuha dechol orchin setimin kama) vechach hi uchamuta deena uchama, dechalil vesatim kol shear uchamin. vesucharaneh dehahu uchama, aschar chad chuta sumaka, (sefer acher listar chad) veakif lehahu uchama.
Gavvna telitaa. yeroka diroke, dechalil vesatim kol yerokin. uvesocharaneh dehahu yeroka, ascharu teren chutin. chuta sumaka listar chad. vechad chuta uchama listar chad. veakkifin lehahu yeroka.

Vechad istechar (nusach acher itgeli) chivvavra, veistechari ena, kol innun gavvnin la mishtakkechin, umishtakkein letatta (sumeka yeroka ukkama). la itchaze bar hahu chivvavra, denahir meattik yomin. unehirin minneh kol innun diltatta. (nusach acher hu).

Velet gavvna itchazyay, bar hahu chivvavra bilchodoy. uvegin kach istelaku kol marehon desumaka veuchama, deinnun teomin kachada. hada hu dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 4:2) shinnayich keeder hakketzuvot shealu min harachtza shekkullam matimot. may min harachtza. mehahu aschuta deena kaddisha illaa. shekkullam matimot. mitarvan da beda, veitdabbekan da beda. uma deamar shinnayich keeder hakketzuvot, veat amrat shekkullam matimot. kelomar, chivvavra dilhon, kehahu chivvavra deayynin, kad aschan bechivavrta deena illaa.

Veda zeminin leminda tzaddikayyay, lemechoze berucha dechachmeta, kema deat amer (yeshaya ned) ki ayin beayin yiru. ematay beshuv Adonai tziyyon. uchetiv (Bamidbar 14:14) asher ayin beayin nira atta Adonai, ucheden pekichuta deayynin letav.

Veit pekichuta deayynin letav. veit pekichuta deayynin levish. kema dichtiv, (Daniel 9:18) pekach enecha uree shommotenu vegomer. veda hacha letav, ulevish. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 33:20) enecha tirena yerushalam nav shaanan ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lanetzach ha hacha letav ulevish. dela itavid da bela da.

Tana bitzniuta desifra, mahu enecha tirena yerushalam nav shaanan. vechi yerushala 40 nav shaanan hu, veha ketiv (Yeshayahu 1:21) tzedek yalin ba. uvaatar deishtechach tzedek, lav shakit, velav shaanan hu. ella enecha tirena yerushalam nav shaanan, nav shaanan, leattik yomin ittemar, (deyashgach beillen ayynin) dehahu ena shakit veshaanan. ena derachame, ena dela natil meashgachuta da, leashgachuta achara. uvegin kach ketiv (146 amud bet), enecha tirenna chaser yod, vela enecha. uma deamar yerushalam vela tziyyon, hachi itzterich, leachpeyay
1305: Vetana, ketiv (Devarim 11:12) ene Adonai elohecha bah mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana, (hada hu dichtiv tzedek yalin bah dibba ishtechachu gazre dedinin yattir mikkol shear atre) (nusach acher dichtiv tzedek yalin bah dibba ishtechachu gazre dedinin yattir mikkol shear atre vetana, ketiv 2 ene Adonai elohecha bah mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana) ulezimna deate, yishtekach bah ena chad derachame. ena deattika deattikin hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:7) uverachamim gedolim akabbetzech. kevan deamar rachamim, mahu gedolim. ella it rachame, veit rachame. rachame deattik deattikin, innun ikrun rachamim gedolim. rachame dizer anpin, ikrun rachamim setam. (96 hu: mishshum deit beh yemina usemala, dina verachame) uvegin kach uverachamim gedolim akabbetzech, deattik yomin.

Tana behane ayynin, bitren gavvnin minnayyhu, besumaka veuchama, sharan teren dimin. vechad bae kudesha dekudeshin lerachama al yisrael, achit teren dimin, leitbassema beyamma rabba. man yamma rabba. yamma dechachmeta illaa. kelomar deyitsechun benahara (sefer acher bechivvavra) bemabbua denafik mechachmata rabba, umerachem lehu leyisrael.

Chotama. tana bitzniuta desifra, chotama dizer anpin. bechotama ishtemoda partzufa. behay chotama itparsha milla dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 22:9) ala ashan beappo vegomer. ala ashan beappo, behay tenana, itkelalu eshsha, vegachale denura. delet (sefer acher bechotama ishtemoda partztzufa telat shalehavebayn matevakedan banevakebavey mehay chotama atepashetan telat gevavne tenana vaessa vegachale denura dichtiv, 1 ala ashan beappo. velet) tenana bela eshsha, vela eshsha bela tenana. vechullehu isteliku (sefer acher atedaleykev) venafke mechotamoy.

Vetana, kad itchabbaru telat illen, dichlilan behay tenana, denafik mechutama. itkamat chotama, venashiv venafik tenana uchama vesumaka. uven tere (nusach acher bitre) gevavne. vekarenan leh, af vechema umashchit. vei tema af vechema ketiv, (Devarim 9:19) ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema, deinnun tenana uchama vesumaka, mashchit mena lan. dichtiv, (Bereshit 13:10) lifne shachet Adonai et sedom veet amora. shachet hammashchit, benura dalik mokda.

Vetana, chamesh gevuran innun, behay zeer anpin. veistellaku leelef vearba mea gevuran. umitpashtan bechotamoy. befuma. bidrooy. bidin. beetzbein. uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai. gevurot ketiv, ketiv hacha gevurot, uchetiv hatam, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) lecha Adonai haggedula vehaggevura. ella hachi tana, kad itchabberan kullehu gevuran kachada, itkere gevura chada.

Vechullehu gevuran, sherian lenachta mechotamoy. umehay talyayn, elef (alfin) vearba mea ribbo, lechol chad minnayyhu. uvehay tenana deappik mechotamoy, talyayn elef (alfin ribbo) vearba mea (vechamesh) distar gevura da. vechullehu gevuran talyayn mehay chotama, dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:4) dor ledor yeshabbach maasecha vegomer. vechad share gevura da, kullehu gevuran mitlahatan veshatan, (nusach acher venachtin) ad denachtan lelahat hacherev hammithappechet.

Ketiv, (Bereshit 19:13) ki mashchitim anachnu et hammakom hazze. uchetiv (Bereshit 13:10) lifne shachet Adonai et sedom et amora. uchetiv, (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora. ella hachi tana, lo dayyayn larshaim vechulei, ella dimhappeche middat rachamim lemiddat haddin.

Veheach mehappeche, veha ketiv (Malachi 3:6) ani Adonai lo shaniti. ella bechol zimna deattik deattike, resha chivvavra, (itgalyay) raava deraavin, itgalyayn, rachamin ravrevin ishtechachu becholla. uveshaata dela itgalyay, kol zayyeynin (sefer acher dinin) dizer appin zeminin, vechivyachol rachame, avid dina, hahu attika decholla.
