Detanya, kad itgalyay attika deattikin, raava deraavin, kullehu botzine deitkerun bishma da, nehirin. verachame ishtechachu becholla. uveshaata dela itgele temira ditmirin, vela itnaharan illen botzine. mitarin dinin, veitavid dina. man garim lehay dina. raava deraavin dela itgele, uvegin kach mehappechin chayyayvayya rachame ledina. uma deamar hacha, meet Adonai min hashshamayim. bizer appin ittemar. umashma dichtiv min hashshamayim, esh umayim. rachame vedina. leappaka man delet beh dina kelal.
Tana, hay chotama zeer. vechad share tenana
1306: Leappaka, nafik bivhilu, veitaved dina. uman meakkev lehay chotama dela yafik tenana, chotama deattika kaddisha, dehu ikre erech appayim mikkolla.

Vehayeynu raza detanenan, (Shemot 34) Adonai Adonai pasik taama begavavyyhu. bechullehu atar dishma adkar tere zimne, pasik taama begavavyyhu, kegon (Bereshit 22:11) avraham avraham. (Bereshit 46:2) yaakov yaakov. (Shmuel 1 3:10) shemuel shemuel. kullehu pasik taama begavavyyhu. chutz mimmoshe moshe, dela pasik taama begavavyyhu. may tama. avraham avraham, batraa shelim, kadmaa la shelim, dehashta shelim beeser nisyone, uvegin kach pasik taama begavavyyhu, dehashta la hava ihu kidkadmeta.

Yaakov yaakov, batraa shelim, kadmaa la shelim, dehashta itbassar beyosef, vesharat aleh shechinta. veod, dehashta ishtelim beara, ilana kaddisha kegavvna dilella, bitresar techumin, beshivin anfin, ma dela hava bekadmita. uvegine kach, batraa shelim, kadmaa la shelim, ufasik taama begavavyyhu. shemuel shemuel, taama pasik begavih. may tama. batraa shelim, kadmaa la shelim, dehashta hu nevia, vekodem lachen la hava nevia. aval moshe moshe, la afsik taama begavavyyhu, demiyyoma deityelid, shelim hava. dichtiv, (Shemot 2:2) vattere oto ki tov hu.

Uf hacha Adonai Adonai, pasik taama begavvavyyhu, kadmaa shelim, batraa shelim bechullehu. umoshe, baatar dina amar, lenachta lon meattika kaddisha, rachamin lizer anpin. dehachi tanenan, kama chela demoshe, deachit mechilan derachame letatta. vechad itgele attika bizer appin, kolla berachame itchazun. vechotama ishtechich, vaeshsha utenana la nafik, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 48:9) utehillati echotam lach.

Vetana, bitren nukevin dechotama, bechad nukeba nafik tenana, lahit, umishtakkea benukeba dithoma rabba. umechad nukeba, nafik eshsha deokid beshalhovoy, umitlahata (bearba elef) beelef vearba mea almin devistar semala. uman degarim lekarva behay, ikre esh Adonai. eshsha deachla veokid kol shear eshshin. vehay eshsha la itbesam, ella beeshsha demadbecha. vehay tenana denafik minnukeva achara, la itbesam ella bitnana dekarbena. (demadbecha).

Vecholla talyay bechotama, begin kach ketiv, (Bereshit 8:21) vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach. decholla bechotama talyayn, learcha hay chotama, bitnana, veeshsha sumaka. uvegin kach itkabbal beraava. vehay (hu) dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:9) vayyichar af Adonai. (Devarim 11:17) vechara af Adonai. (Shemot 22:23) vechara appi. (Devarim 6:15) pen yechore af Adonai. kolla bizer appin ittemar, vela beattika. tana, ketiv (Daniel 9:18) hatte elohay aznecha ushama hay (sefer acher tana batzenayavetaa desifra darga 7 amika lemishma tav uvish veda) ihu udena deitavid techot sare. veshare talyayn aleh. (veudena hu lemishma) veudena itavid berishume reshimin legau. kema deavid (sefer acher dakearey) darga beakima, (lehay ulehay) may tama beakima. (sefer acher begin daytaakab kala leaala lemocha veyavchin bemocha velo bivhilu) begin lemishma tav uvish vetana, mehay akima divgo udenin, talyayn kol innun mare degadfin, dichtiv behu, (Kohelet 10:20) ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol uvaal kenafayim yaggid davar.

Bego udena, natif mig challe democha, lehay nukeba deudenin. umehahu netifa, ayel kala behahu akima, veittzerif behahu netifa, ben tav uven bish. tav, dichtiv, (Tehillim 69:34) ki shomea el evyonim Adonai. bish, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 11:1) vayyishma Adonai vayyichar appo vattivar bam esh Adonai.

Vehay udena satim levar. vaakima ayel lego, lehahu nukeba dintifa min mocha, begin lemichnash kala legau, dela yippuk levar, vihe natir vesatim mikkol sitroy. begin kach hu raza. vavy lehahu dimgale razin, deman dimgale razin keillu achchish tikkuna dilella. deittekan lemichnash razin, vela yippekun levar.

Tanya, beshaata detzavvchin yisrael beaka, vesare mitgalyayn meal udenin, keden ayel kala beudenin, behahu nukeba denatif mimmocha, vechanash (uvatash) bemocha. venafik benukeve dechotama. veitzear chotama, veitchammam, (sefer acher vaatakemat) venafik eshsha utenana meinnun nukevin, umitarin
1307: Vead la nafkin meinnun nukevin eshsha utenanasalik hahu kala leella, uvatash berecha democha (sefer acher beresha bemocha), venagdin teren dimin meayyeynin, venafak minnechiroy tenana veesha, behahu kala denagid lon levar.

Behahu kala deayil beudenin, itmashshechan umittearan (sefer acher mitarvin) kule hay, begin kach ketiv, vayyishma Adonai vayyichar appo vattivar bam esh Adonai. behahi shemia dehahu kala, ittear mocha. (kolla) tana, ketiv hatte elohay aznecha, kelomar arkin (sefer acher udenin). shit mea elef ribbo innun marehon degadfin, detalyayn beillen udenin. vecholla itkerun azne Adonai. uma deittemar hatte Adonai aznecha, aznecha bizer appin ittemar.

Missitra dechad challala democha talyayn udenin. umechamshin tarin denafkin mehahu challala, da hu (sefer acher it) tara chad, denagid venafik veitpetach behahu nukeba deudena, dichtiv, (Iyov 34:3) ki ozen millin tivchan. uchetiv (Tehillim 7:10) uvochen libbot uchelayot. umissitra deitpashshetuta dehahu challala, dechamshin tarin deitpashshetuta begufa, baatar delibba share, mitpashshat hahu challala dechamshin tarin, veudena kare beh bechina, uvelibba kare beh bechina, mishshum demeatar chad mitpashshetin. (sefer acher behahu nukeba daavadenaa umissitra daatapeshatevatea dehahu chalelaa dechamshin tarin itpashat begufa baatar delibba share veal da baavadenaa kare beh bechina uvelibba kare beh bechina dichtiv ki ozen millin tivchan uchetiv bochen libbot uchelayot mishshum dameater chad mitpashshetin)

Tana bitzniuta desifra, kema deudena da avchin ben tav uven bish, kach kolla. devizer appin it sitra detav uvish. yemina usemala. rachame vedina. vehay udena kelil bemocha umishshum deitkelil bemocha vbachalala chad. itkelil bekala deayil beh. uveudena kare beh shemia. uvishmia itkelil bina. shema: kelomar, haven ishtechach (sefer acher veistakkal) decholla bechad matkela itkal. umillin illen lemarehon demarin ityehavan, lemishma uleistakkela uleminda.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Chavakuk 3:2) Adonai shamati shimacha yareti vegomer, hay kera ishtemoda, dechad nevia kaddisha, (sefer acher mehemana) shama, veistakkal, veyada, vekaim al tikkunin illen, ketiv yareti, tamman yaut hu ledachala uleitabbar kammeh, hay bizer appin ittemar.

Kad istakkal veyada ma ketiv. Adonai paalcha bekerev shanim chayyehu. hay leattik yomin ittemar. uvakkol atar deyishtechach, Adonai Adonai, beYod hei tere zimne, o bealef dalet, veyud hei, chad lizer appin, vechad leattika deattikin. veaf al gav dechullehu chad, vechad shema ikru.

Vetanenan ematay ikre shem malle. bezimna dichtiv Adonai elohim. dehay hu shem malle deattik decholla, vedizer anpin. vecholla hu shem malle ikre. ushear la ikre shem malle, kema deokimna, (Bereshit 2:8) vayyitta Adonai elohim, shem malle bintiot ginta. uvechol atar, Adonai elohim, itkere shem malle. Adonai Adonai, kolla hu bichlala. vehahu zimna ittearun rachamin becholla.

Adonai paalcha bekerev shanim chayyehu, leattik yomin ittemar. man paalcha. zeer appin. bekkerev shanim, innun shanim kadmoniyyot, deikrun yeme kedem, vela ikrun shenot olam. shanim kadmoniyyot innun yeme kedem. shenot olam illen yeme olam. vehacha bekerev shanim, man shanim. shanim kadmoniyyot. chayyehu leman. chayyehu lizer appin. dechol nehiru dileh meinnun shanim kadmoniyyot itkayyaymu, uvegin kach amar chayyehu. berogez rachem tizkor, lehahu chesed illaa deattika deattikin, deveh ittear rachamin lecholla, leman devae lerachama, uleman deyeot lerachama.

Tana, amar rabbi shimon, ashadna alay shemaya, ulechol illen dealana kayymin. dechaddan millin illen, bechullehu almin. vechaddan belibbai millay, uvego parochta illaa difrisa alana, mittammerin, vesallekin, veganiz lehu attika decholla, ganiz vesatim mikkolla. vechad sharena lemallela, la havo yadin chavrayya, dechol hane millin kaddishin mitarin hacha. zakkaa chulakechon chavrayyay dehacha. vezakkaa chulaki immechon, bealma den uvealma deate.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem vegomer. man amma kaddisha keyisrael, dichtiv bohu (Devarim 33:29) ashrecha yisrael mi chamocha, dichtiv (Shemot 15:11) mi chamocha baelim Adonai. mishshum deitdabbekuta dilhon hu bishma kaddisha bealma den. uvealma deate yattir mehacha.
1308: Dehatam la mitparshan minneh, mehahu tzerora ditzririn beh tzaddikayya, hada hu dichtiv veattem haddevekim baAdonai, vela ketiv haddevekim laAdonai, ella baAdonai mammash.

Tana, kad nachit min dikna yakkira illaa, deattika kaddisha, satim vetamir mikkolla, mishcha dirvut kaddisha, ledikna dizer appin. ittakkan dikna dileh, betisha tikkunin. uveshaata denahir dikna yakkira deattika deattikin, behay dikna dizer appin, nagdin telesar mabbuin demishcha illaa, behay dikna. umishtachchin beh, esrin uteren tikkunin. uminneh nagdin, esrin uteren atvavn (sefer acher deorayyta) dishma kaddisha. (matchil missof 138 amud bet) (nusach acher uvealma deate, mishshum deitdabbekuta dilhon hu bishma kaddisha bealma din uvealma deate yattir mehacha dehatam lo mitparshin mehahu tzerora dechayye datzeraverayn beh tzaddikayyay hada hu dichtiv veattem haddevekim baAdonai baAdonai mammash alayychu ketiv ashrecha yisrael mi kamocha im nosha baAdonai uchetiv mi kamocha baelim Adonai hasheta atekavevanev data laavakevarey lemalka uleokir yikkare dadeykenaa kaddisha demalka, tanna mittakken dikna illaa dikna kaddisha 11 tikkunin veda ihu dikna dizer anpin vechad nachit min dikna yakkira ilaa deattika kaddisha behay dikna dizer anpin nagdin 13 mabbuin demishcha ilaa behay dikna umishtachchin beh 22 tikkunin uminneh nagdin 22 atvavn 404) veim tomar dikna la ishtechach, velo amar shelomo ella (Shir HaShirim 5) lechayav. (velo kare dikna) ella hachi tana bitzniuta desifra, kol ma deatmar veganiz, vela idkar vela itgalyay. hahu milla havi illaa veyakkira mikkolla, (mishshum) uvegin da hu satim veganiz. vedikna mishshum dehu shevacha ushelemuta, veyakiruta mikkol partzufa, ganzeh kera, vela itgalyay.

Vetana, hay dikna deihu shelemuta defartzufa veshappiruta dizer appin, nafik meudenoy, venachit vesalik vechafe, betakrova devusema. may takruva devusema. kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim Adonai:13) lechayav kaarugat habbosem (velo arugot). betisha tikkunin, ittakkan hay dikna dizer anpin. besaare (dadeykenaa) uchame, mittatkena betikkuna shappir. kegibbar takkif shappir lemecheze. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) bachur kaarazim.

Tikkuna kadmaa. metatkkan saara milleella, venafik hahu nitzotza (Bereshit 9 amud alef) butzina dekardinuta, venafik mikkelala daavira dachya, uvatash bitchot saara deresha, mittechot kotzin deal udenin. venachit mikkamme pitcha deudenin nime al nime, ad resha defuma.
Tikkuna tinyayna. nafik saara, vesalik meresha defuma, ad resha achara defitcha defuma. venachit mittechot puma, ad resha achara, nimin al nimin, betikkuna shappira.

Tikkuna telitaa. meemtzaita ditchot chotama, mittechot teren nukevin, nafik chad archa, vesaarin zeirin takkifin, malyayn lehahu archa, ushear saarin malyayn mehay gisa, umehay gisa, socharaneh dehahu archa. vearcha la itchaze letatta kelal, ella hahu archa dilella, denachit ad resha desifvavtan, vetamman shekia hahu archa.

Tikkuna reviaa. nafik saara, veittakkan, vesalik vechappe beiloy detikrova devusema. tikkuna chamishaa. pasik saara, veitchazyayn teren tappuchin, mikkan umikkan, sumakan kehay varda sumaka. umitlahatan bematan veshivin almin, demitlahatin mittamman (sefer acher minnehon). tikkuna shetitaa. nafik saara kechad chuta besacharaneh dedikna, vetalyayn ad resha demeoy, vela nachit ad tabbura. tikkuna sheviaa. dela talyayn sare al puma, ufuma itpene mikkol sitroy. veyatvin sare betikkuna sechor sechor leh.

Tikkuna teminaa. denachtin sare bitchot dikna, dimchappeyayn kedala, dela itchazya. kullehu sare dekikin, nimin al nimin. malyayn mikkol sitroy. tikkuna teshiaa. (mitarvin shaare im inun) demitchabberan (nusach acher itmashshechan) sare kullehu beshikkula mealleyay, (sefer acher malyay) ad (nusach acher im) innun sare detalyayn. kullehu beshikkula shappir, kechad gibbar takkif, mare natzach keravin.

Betisha tikkunin illen, nagdin venafkin 9 mabbuin dimshach revut dilella. umehahu meshach revut, nagdin lechol innun diltatta. 9 tikkunin illen ishtechachu bedikna da. uvishlemut tikkuna dedikna da, itkere (bar nash letatta) gibbar takkif. dechol man dechame dikna kayyeyma bekiyyumeh, talyay beh gevura takifa. ad kan tikkuna dedikna illaa dizer appin.
Amar ribbi shimon leribbi elazar bereh, kum beri (kaddisha), salsel tikkuna dedikna (nusach acher demalka) kaddisha, betikkunoy illen.
1309: Kam ribbi elazar, patach veamar, (Tehillim 118:5) min hammetzar karati yah anani vamerchav yah vegomer. ad mibbetoach bindivim. tana, hacha 9 tikkunin divdikna da. lehane tikkunin itzterich david malka, begin lenatzcha lishar malchin, velishar ammin.

Ta chaze, kevan deamar hane 9 tikkunin, levatar amar kol goyim sevavuni beshem Adonai ki amilam. amar, hane tikkunin daamena, lemay itzterichna. mishshum dechol goyim sevavuni. uvetikkuna dedikna da, 9 tikkunin, deinnun shem Adonai, ashetzinun min alma, hada hu dichtiv beshem Adonai ki amilam.
Vetana bitzniuta desifra, tisha tikkunin amar david, hacha, shita innun bishma kaddisha. deshit shemahan havo, utelat adam. vei tema teren innun. telata havo, deha nedivim bichlal adam havo.

Tana shita shemahan, dichtiv: min hammetzar karati yah, chad. anani vamerchav yah, teren. Adonai li lo ira, telat. Adonai li beozray, arba. tov lachasot baAdonai, chamishsha. tov lachasot baAdonai, shita. adam telat, dichtiv: Adonai li lo ira ma yaase li adam, chad. tov lachasot baAdonai mibbetoach baadam, tere. tov lachasot baAdonai mibbetoach bindivim, telat.

Veta chaze raza demilla, divchol atar deidkar adam hacha, la idkar ella bishma kaddisha. dehachi itchaze. mishshum dela ikre (hava) adam, ella bema deitchaze leh. umay itchaze leh. shema kaddisha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam, beshem male, dehu Adonai elohim. kema deitchaze leh uvegin kach hacha la idkar adam ella bishma kaddisha.

Vetana, ketiv min hammetzar karati yah anani vamerchav yah, tere zimne yah yah, lokovel tere iloy, desare itachadan behu. umidchama desare itmashshechan vetalyayn, share veamar Adonai li lo ira. Adonai li beozray. bishma dela chaser. bishma dehu kaddisha. uvishma da, adkar adam.

Uma deamar ma yaase li adam, hachi hu. detana kol innun kitrin kaddishin demalka, kad ittaknan betikkunoy. itkerun adam. diyyukena dechalil kolla. uma demashlefa behu, itkere shema kaddisha. vetara uma deveh, itkere Adonai, veitkere adam bichlala detara, uma deveh.

Veillen tisha tikkunin deamar david hacha, leachnea sanoy begin deman deachid dikna demalka, veokir leh beyakiru illaa, kol ma devae min malka. malka avid begineh. may tama dikna, vela gufa. ella gufa azil batar dikna, vedikna la azil batar gufa. (sefer acher uma daashatelayf matearea itkere shemma kaddisha, taaraa uma deveh itkere Adonai itkere adam becholla taaraa uma deveh) (39 min vadeykenaa ad vegufa)

Uvitre gevavne ate hay chushebana, chad kidkamran. teren: min hammetzar karati yah, chad. anani vamerchav yah, tere. Adonai li lo ira, telat. ma yaase li adam, arba. Adonai li beozray, chamesh. vaani ere beshonay, shita. tov lachasot baAdonai, shiva. mibbetoach baadam, temanyay. tov lachasot baAdonai mibbetoach bindivim, tisha. (sefer acher tov lachasot baAdonai, mabetavech baadam. 7. tov lachasot baAdonai. 8. mabetavech bindivim)

Min hammetzar karati yah, may ka mayyre ella david, kol ma deamar hacha, al tikkuna dedikna da kaamar. (rabbi yehuda amar) min hammetzar karati yah, meatar deshari dikna leitpashta, dehu atar dachik, mikkamme pitcha deudenin meella, techot sare deresha. uvegin kach amar yah ya tere zimne. uvaatar (sefer acher uvatar) deitpeshat dikna, venachit meudenoy, veshari leitpashta, amar Adonai li lo ira, dehu atar dela dachil (sefer acher dachek) vechol hay itzterich vechulei, (adam itkere veal itpashshetuta hay itzterich) david leachna techoteh malchin veammin, begin yekara dedikna da.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, kol man dechame bechelmeh dedikna devar nash illaa achid bideh, o deoshit yedeh leh. yinda dishlim hu im illae, vearme techoteh innun dimtzaarin leh. tana, metatkkan dikna illaa betisha tikkunin, vehu dikna dizer appin, bet tikkunin metatkkan.
1310: Kadmaa. metatkkan saara meella, venafik mikkamme pitcha deudenin, mittechot kotze detalyayn al udenin, venachtin sare, nimin al nimin, ad resha defuma. tana, kol illen nimin divdikna, takkifin yattir mikkol nimin dekotzin desare deresha, vesare deresha arichin (vakepayyn), vehane lav arichin, vesare deresha, minnehon sheie, uminhon keshishin.
Uveshaata deitmashshechan sare chivvavre deattik yomin, lesare dizer appin, ketiv, (Mishlei 1:20) chachmot bachutz taronna. may bachutz. behay zeer appin. demitchabberan tere moche.

Tere moche salleka datach. ella ema arba moche. telat moche dahavo bizer appin, veishtechachu bitlat chalale degulegalta deresha. vechad mocha shakit al bureyeh, dechalil kol telat moche. deitmeshach minneh meshichan kelilan shekilan, besaare chivvavre. lehay zeer appin litlat moche deveh.

Umishtachchan arba moche behay zeer appin. begin kach ishtelimu arba parashiyyot dichtivin battefillin, deitkelil behu shema kaddisha deattik yomin, attika deattikin, uzeer appin. dehay hu shelemuta dishma kaddisha. dichtiv, (Devarim 28:10-11) verau chol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha vayyiru mimmekka. shem Adonai. shem Adonai mamash, deinnun arba rehite batte ditfillin.

Uvegin kach, (131 amud bet, 262 amud alef) chachmot bachutz taronna. dehacha mishtakkechin. deha attika deattikin, setima distimin, la ishtechach, vela zammin chachmeta dileh, mishshum deit chachmeta setima decholla vela itperash. uvegin deitchabbaru arbaa mochin behay zeer appin. itmashshechan arba mabbuin minneh learba ivar, umitparshan mechad mabbua, denafik mekullehu. uvegin kach innun arba.

Vetana, hay chachmeta deitkelila bearba, itmashshecha behane sare, deinnun talyayn tillin al tillin. (nusach acher hu) vechullehu kashyayn vetakifin, veitmashshechu unegidu kol chad lesitroy. veelef alfin veribbo ribbevan talyayn, minnayyhu delethon bechushebana. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:11) kevutztzotav taltallim. tile tillim. vechullehu kashyayn vetakifin leitchabbera, kehay challamish takkif. uchehay tinra deihi takkifa. ad deavdin nukevin umabbuin mittechot saara, venagdin mabbuin takkifin lechol ivar veivar lechol setar usetar. uvegin dehane sare uchame vachashochan, ketiv (Iyov 12:22) megalle amukot minni choshech vayyotze laor tzalmavt.
Vetana, hane sare dedikna takkifin (bilchodi) mishshear sare deresha, mishshum dehane bilchodayyhu mitparshan umishtachchan, veinnun takkifin beorchayyhu.
Amay takkifin. i tema, mishshum dechullehu dina, lav hachi, deha betikunin illen ishtechachu rachame (vedina). uveshaata denachtin telesar mabbue nahare demishcha, illen kullehu rachame.

Ella tana, kol hane sare dedikna, kullehu takkifin. may tama. kol innun derachame, bayayn lemehevi takkifin. leachpeyay ledina. vechol innun deinhu dina, ha takkifin innun. uven kach uven kach bayayn lemehevi takkifin, mitteren sitrin. kad bae alma rachamin, rachame takkifin venatzchin al dina. vechad bae dina, dina takkif, venatzach al rachame. uvegin kach bayayn lemehevi takkifin mitteren sitrin, dechad bau rachame, sare deinnun berachame, kayymin umitchazya (sefer acher mateachedaa) dikna beinnun sare, vecholla havo rachame. vechad bayay dina, itchazyay dikna beinnun sare. vecholla itkayyaym bedikna.

Vechad itgalyay dikna kaddisha chivvavra, kol hane vechol hane mitnaharin umistachyayn, keman deisteche benahara amika mimma dehava beh. veitkeyaymu kullehu berachame, velet dina ishtechach, vechol hane tisha kad naharin kachada, kullehu istachyayn berachame.

Uvegin kach amar moshe zimna achara, (Bamidbar 14:18) Adonai erech appayim verav chesed. veillu emet la kaamar. mishshum deraza demilla, innun tisha mechilan denaharin meattik yomin lizer appin. vechad amar moshe zimna tinyayna, tisha tikkunin amar. veinhu tikkune dikna demishtakkeche bizer appin, venachtin meattik yomin venaharin
1311: Beh. uvegin kach emet talyay beattika, vehashsheta la amar moshe veemet.

Tana, sare deresha dizer appin, kullehu keshishe, tillin al tillin. vela sheiin. deha chamena ditlat moche bitlat chalale mishtakkechin beh, unehirin mimmocha setimaa. umishshum democha deattik yomin, shakit veshachich kachamar tav al duredyeh, saaroy kullehu sheiin, umeshichin bemishcha tav. uvegin kach ketiv, (Daniel 7:9) reshe kaamar neke.

Vehay dizer appin, keshishin vela keshishin. deha kullehu talyayn vela mitkamte, uvegin kach chachmeta nagid venafik. aval la chachmeta dechachmeta, deihi shechicha ushekita. deha tanena delet deyada mocheh deattik yomin, bar ihu. vehay dichtiv, (Iyov 28:23) elohim hevin darkah vehu yada et mekomah, (129 amud bet) bizer appin ittemar. amar ribbi shimon, berich beri lekudesha berich hu, bealma den uvealma deate.
Tikkuna tinyayna. nafik saara, vesalik meresha defuma, ad resha achara defitcha defuma, venachit mittechot puma, ad resha achara, nimin al nimin, betikkuna shappir.

Kum ribbi abba. kam ribbi abba, patach veamar, kad tikkuna dedikna da mittakkan betikkuna demalka, (sefer acher bateykevaney malchin) (sefer acher kad tikkuna da mittakken badekna demalka itchaze) kegibbar takkif shappir lemechoze, rav veshalit, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:5) gadol adonenu verav koach. vechad itbesam betikkuna dikna yakkira kaddisha, veyishgach beh, ikre binhiru dileh, el rachum vegomer. vehay tikkuna tinyayna ittakkan, kad nahir binhiru deattik yomin, ikre rav chesed. vechad mistakkele da beda, itkere betikkuna achara veemet. deha nehiru anpe. (sefer acher da nehiru deanpin)

Vetana, nose avon itkere da tikkuna tinyayna, kegavvna deattika kaddisha. aval mishshum hahu orcha denafik, betikkuna telitaa techot teren nukevin dechotama, vesaarin takkifin zeirin malyayn lehahu orcha. la itkerun hacha nose avon veover al pesha, veitkeyaymu beatar achara.

Vetanya, telat mea veshivin vechamesh chasadim, kelilan bechesed deattik yomin, vechullehu ikrun chasde kadmae. dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:50) ayye chasadecha harishonim. vechullehu kelilan bechesed deattika kaddisha, setima decholla. vechesed dizer appin ikre chesed olam.

Uvesifra ditzniuta, (Shemot 177 amud bet) kere beh lechesed kadmaa deattik yomin rav chesed. uvizer appin, chesed setam. uvegin kach ketiv hacha, (Shemot 34) verav chesed. uchetiv, (Shemot 34:6-7) notzer chesed laalafim setam. veokimna, hay rav chesed, matte kelappe chesed, lenahara leh, uleadlaka botzine.

Detana hay orcha denachit techot teren nukevin dechotama, vesarin zeirin malyayn lehahu archa, la ikre hahu archa over al pesha, delet atar leabera leh bitre gevavne. chad mishshum sare deishtechach behahu archa, hu atar kashya leabera. vechad, mishshum denachit abera dehahu orcha ad resha defuma, vela yattir.

Veal da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:13) siftotav shoshannim, sumakin kevarda, notfot mor over, sumaka takkif, vehay orcha dehacha, bitre gevavne lo (sefer acher bitre gevavne agezaym velo) itbesam. mikkan man devae leagzema, tere zimne batash bideh behay orcha.

Tikkuna reviaa nafik saara, veittakkan, vesalik vechappe beiloy, betikruveta devusema. hay tikkuna yae veshappira, leitchazya hod vehadar hu (sefer acher hod illaa). vetanya, hod illaa, nafik veitattar venagid leitachada (sefer acher layah daalaayn) beiloy, veitkere hod zakan. umehay hod vehadar, talyayn illen levushe, deitlabbash behu, veinnun purepira yakkira demalka. dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:1) hod vehadar lavashta, tikkunin deitlabbash behu, veittakkan behay diyyukena deadam, yattir mikkol diukenin.
1312: Hay hod, kad itnehar binhiru dedikna illaa, (nusach acher da) veitpashshat bishar tikkunin nehirin. hay hu nose avon mehay gisa, veover al pesha mehay gisa. uvegin kach, (Shir HaShirim 5) lechayav ketiv. uvitzniuta desifra ikre, hod vehadar vetiferet. deha tiferet hu over al pesha, shenneemar (Mishlei 19:11) vetifarto avor al pesha. aval hay tiferet la okimna, ella betikkuna teshiaa, kema deat amer vetiferet bachurim kocham. vetamman ikre tiferet. vechad ittekal (sefer acher istakkal), bematkela chad sallekin. amar rabbi shimon, yeot ant ribbi abba, leitbarcha meattika kaddisha, dechol birchan nafkin minneh.

Tikkuna chamishaa. pasik saara, veitchazun teren tappuchin mikkan umikkan, sumakan kehay varda sumaka. umitlahatan bematan veshivin almin, hane tere tappuchin, kad neharin (muttarin sitrin) minnehiru ditren tappuchin kaddishin illain deattika, itmeshach sumaka, veate chivvara. behay ketiv, (Bamidbar 6:25) yaer Adonai panav elecha vichunnecha. dechad neharin mitberach alma. uveshaata deitavidu sumaka, ketiv yissa Adonai panav elecha, kelomar yistalak. vela yishtekach rugeza bealma. tana, kullehon nehorin deitnaharan meattika kaddisha, itkerun chasde kadmae. uvegin innun, naharin kol innun chasde olam.

Tikkuna shetitaa. nafik saara, kechad chuta desaare besacharaneh dedikna. (sefer acher vetalyayn ad resha dameavey velo nachit ad tabevarea, tanna tikkuna da hu deikre) peat hazzakan veihu chad mechamesh pein, detalyayn bechesed (uverachame), vela ive lechabbela hay chesed, kema deittemar. uvegin kach, (Vayikra 19:27) lo tashchit et peat zekanecha ketiv.

Tikkuna sheviaa. dela talyayn saara al puma, ufuma itpene mikkol sitroy, veyatvin sarin betikkuna sechor sechor leh. kum ribbi yehuda. kam ribbi yehuda, patach veamar, (Daniel 4:14) bigzerat irin pitgama. kema elef ribbevan mitneshan (sefer acher mateysheban) umitkayyeyman behay puma, vetalyayn minneh, vechulhon ikrun pe. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 33:6) uveruach piv kol tzevaam. umehahu rucha denafik mippuma, mitlabbeshan.

Kol innun dilvar, talyayn mehay puma. umehay puma (sefer acher rucha) kad itpashat hay rucha, mitlabbeshan beh kama nevie mehemna, vechullehu pe Adonai itkerun. uvaatar derucha nafik, la itarva milla achara vechullehu (fiyyot) mechakkan leitlabbesha behahu rucha denafik. vehay tikkuna shallita al kullehu shita. mishshum dehacha mitkayyeyman kullehu umitachadan. uvegine kach sarohy shekilin socharaneh defuma. veitpene mikkol sitroy, vehay tikkuna shallita al kullehu mishshum dehacha mitkayyeyman kullehu umitachadan. amar rabbi shimon, berich ant leattika kaddisha.

Tikkuna teminaa denachtin sare bitchot dikna, mechappeyayn kedala dela itchaze. detanya, en lemala lo oref velo ifoy, uvezimna deaggach (sefer acher denatzach) kerave itchaze. mishshum leachazaa gevureta. deha tanenan, elef almin itachadayn minneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:4) elef hammagen taluy alav kol shilte haggibborim. veelef hammagen raza hu. bitzniuta desifra, kol shilte haggibborim deatu missetar gevura chad, meinnun gevuran.

Tikkuna teshiaa. deitmashshechan (sefer acher demitchabberan) sare beshikkula malya, im innun sare detalyayn, kullehu beshikkula shappir, kechad gibbar takkif, mare natzchan keravayyay. mishshum dechullehu sare itmashshechan batar innun detalyayn. uchelala dechullehu beinnun detalyayn. vecholla itmeshach, (chaser kan) veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 20:29) tiferet bachurim kocham. (venire al hayyam kabechaver tov hada hu dichtiv) ketiv (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) bachur kaarazim, kegibbar avid gevuran, veda hu tiferet, chela ugevureta verachame.

Tana, amar rabbi shimon kol hane tikkunin, vechol hane millin, baena legallaa lemarehon deittekalu bematkela, vela leinnun dela alu (nusach acher dealu velo nafku) ella leillen dealu venafku, dechol maen deayil vela nafik, tav leh dela ivre.

Kelala dechol millin, attika deattikin, uzeer appin, kolla chad. kolla hava. kolla havi. kolla yehe. la yishtane. vela mishtane. vela shena. ittakkan betikunin illen. ishtelim diyyukena dechalil kol diukenin. diyyukena dechalil kol shemahan. diyyukena
1313: Deitchaze begoone kehay diyyukena (nusach acher begavvivy kol diukenin) lav hay diyyukena havi, ella keen hay diyyukena.

Kad itchabberan itrin vechitrin, keden hu ashlemuta decholla. begin, dediyyukena deadam, havi diyyukena deillain vetattain deitkelalu beh. uvegin dehay diyyukena kalil illain vetattain, atkin attika kaddisha tikkunoy, vetikkuna dizer appin, behay diyyukena vetikkuna.

Vei tema ma ben hay lehay. kolla hu bematkela chada, aval mikkan (nusach acher minnan) itparshan archoy. (nusach acher atepashetan rachame) umikkan (nusach acher vamenan) ishtechach dina. umissitra dilan havo shanyayn da min da. verazin illen la itmesaru, bar limchatztzede chakla kaddisha. uchetiv (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav.

Ketiv (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam, bitre yodin. ashlim tikkuna go tikkuna, tavreka degushepanka. veda hu vayyitzer. teren yodin lamma. raza deattika kaddisha, veraza dizer appin. vayyitzer, may tzar. tzar tzura bego tzura. (veda hu vayyitzer) umahu tzura bego tzura. teren shemahan, deitkere shem malle, Adonai elohim. veda hu raza ditren yodin devayyitzer, detzar tzura go tzura. tikkuna dishma shelim, Adonai elohim.
Uvema itkelilu. bediyyukena illaa da, deikre adam. dechalil dechar venukeba. veal da ketiv et haadam dechalil dechar venukeba. et: leappaka ulemisge zina denafik minneh. (midkar venukeba)

Afar min haadama: diyyukena bego diyyukena. vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim: tavreka degushepanka go bego. vechol da lamma. begin leishtallefa uleayyeyla beh satim distima illaa, ad sofa dechol setimin. (hada hu dichtiv 0 vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim) nishmeta, dechol chayye deella vetatta talyayn mehahi nishmeta, umitkayyme bah.

Vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya, leatterka, uleayyeyla betikunin kegavvna da, uleashlefa lehahi (nusach acher mehahi) nishmeta. middarga ledarga ad sofa dechol dargin. begin dihevi hahi nishmeta mishtakkecha becholla, umitpashsheta becholla. ulemehevi kolla beyichuda chad. uman defasik hay yichuda min alma, keman defasik nishmeta da, umechoze deit nishmeta achara, bar mehay. uvegin kach, yishtetze hu veducherane min alma ledare darin.

Behay diyyukena deadam, shari vetakin kelala dechar venukeba. kad ittakkan hay diyyukena betikkunoy, share mechaddoy, mibben teren deroin. beatar detalyayn sare dedikna, deitkerun (nusach acher deitkere) tiferet. veitpashshat hay tiferet, vetakin teren chaddin, veishtelayf laachoroy, veavad gulegalta denukeba. kolla setima mikkol sitroy. besara befartzufa deresha. uvichlala chada itavidu behay tiferet, veikre adam dechar venukeba. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 44:13) ketiferet adam lashevet bayit.

Kad itbere partzufa deresha denukeba, talyay chad kotza desare meachoroy dizer appin, vetale ad resha denukeba. veittearu sare bereshaha, kullehu sumake dichlilan bego gevavne, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:6) vedallat roshech kaargaman. mahu argaman. gevavne dichlilan bego gevavne.
Tana, itpashat hay tiferet mitabbura delibba, venakiv veitavar begisa achara, vetakin partzufa denukeba ad tabbura. umitabbura share, uvetabbura shelim.

Tu itpeshat hay tiferet, veatkin meoy didchura, veayil (veittakkan) behay atar kol rachamin, vechol sitra derachame. vetana, behane meayyn itachadan, shit mea elef ribbo mare derachame. veitkerun baale meayyn. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:20) al ken hamu meay lo rachem arachamenu neum Adonai.
Tana, hay tiferet, kalil berachame, vechalil bedina, veitpashshat rachame bidchura, veitavar venakiv (sefer acher venahir) listar achara, vetakin meoy denukeba, veittekanu meaha besitra dedina.
Tana, ittakan dechura besitre, bematan utemanya vearbein tikkunin dichlilan beh, uminhon lego, uminnehon levar. minnehon rachame. uminnehon dina. kullehu
1314: Dedina, itachadu bedina daachoroy, denukeba itpashshatat tamman. veitachadu veitpashatu besitraha.

Vetana, chamisha eryayta (nusach acher tikkunin) itgalleyayn ba, besitra dedinin chamishsha. vedinin Adonai (nusach acher besitra dedina vadeynehaa) itpashshetan, bematan vearbein utemanya archin. vehachi tana, kol beishsha erva. sear beishsha erva. shok beishsha erva. yad beishsha erva. regel beishsha erva. deaf al gav ditren illen la shanyuha chavrana, uteren illen yattir meerva innun.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, itpashat dechura veittakkan betikkunoy. ittakkan tikkuna dichsuta dachya. vehaay haveya amma dachya. archeh dehahu amma, matan vearbein utemanya almin. vechullehu talyayn befuma deamma, deitkere yod. vechevan deitgalyay yod pumeh deamma, itgele chesed illaa. vehay amma chesed hu deitkere, vetale (nusach acher vehay chesed hu tale) behay pum amma. vela ikre chesed, ad deitgalyay yod defum amma.

Veta chaze, dela itkere avraham shelim behay chesed, ad deitgalyay yod deamma. vechevan deitgele ikre shelim, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim, tamim mammash. uchetiv (Shmuel 2 22:24) vaehye tamim lo vaeshtammera meavoni. may ka mayyre, resha vesefa. ella kol degalle hay yod, veistemar dela ayyleh leyod birshuta achara. lihevi shelim lealma deate, velehevi tzarir bitzrora dechayye. may birshuta achara. dichtiv, (Malachi 2:11) uvaal bat el nechar. uvegin kach ketiv, vaehye tamim lo, dechevan dehu tamim begilluyay deyod, vaeshtammera meavoni.

Vechevan deitpeshat amma da, itpeshat setar gevura meinnun gevuran (bismala) denukeba, veishteka benukeba baatar chad, vearshim beeryayta, kesutah dechol gufa denukeba. uvehahu atar ikre erva dechola. atar leatznea lehahu amma, deikre chesed. begin leitbassema gevura da dechalil chamesh gevuran, behay chesed dechalil bechamesh chasadin. chesed yemina, gevura semala. itbesam da beda, veikre adam, kalil mitteren sitrin. uvegin kach, bechullehu kitrin it yemina usemala, dina verachame.

Tana, ad la zammin tikkunoy demalka, attika deattikin, bana almin, veatkin tikkunin leitkayyeyma. hahu nukeba la itbasma, vela itkeyaymu, ad denachit (289 amud bet) chesed illaa veitkeyaymu, veitbesamu tikkune nukeba, behay amma deikre chesed. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:31) veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom, atar dechol dinin mishtakkechin tamman (veinnun tikkune itteta, asher hayu lo ketiv ella asher malchu) vela itbesamu, ad deatkan kolla, venafik hay chesed, veityeshav befuma deamma. hada hu dichtiv, vayyamat vayyamat, dela itkeyaymu, vela itbesamu, dina bedina.

Vei tema i hachi dedina kullehu, veha ketiv vayyimloch tachtav shaul merchovot hannahar, veha la itchaze dina. detanenan, rechovot hannahar ihu bina, deminah mitpattechin chamshin tarin dinhorin uvutzinin, leshit sitre alma. tana, kullehu dina, bar mechad deitkayyaym batraa, vehay shaul merchovot hannahar, da hu chad sitra, deitpashat venafik merchovot hannahar.

Vechullehu la itkayaymu, la tema deitbatalu, ella dela itkayaymu behahu malchu, (uvistar nukeba) ad deittear veitpashshat hay batraa mekullehu, dichtiv vayyimloch tachtav hadar. may hadar. chesed illaa. veshem iro pau, may pau. behay pai bar nash dezache lerucha dekudesha veshem ishto mehetavel, bechan itbesamu da beda, veitkere ishto, ma dela ketiv bechullehu.
Mehetavel, itbasmuta deda beda. bat matred, tikkunin demissetar gevura. bat me zahav, itbesamu veitkelilu da beda, me zahav: rachame vedina. kan itdabbeku itteta bidchura.
Besitroy, itparshan bidroin, bashokin. deroin didchura, chad yemina, chad semala deroa kadmaa (sefer acher kaddisha)
1315: Telat kishrin itkashsharu beh, veitkelilu 2 deroin. veitkelilu salleka datach. ella 3 kishrin bimina, veg kishrin bismala. 3 kishrin dimina, itkelilan beg kishrin dismala. uvegin kach, deroa la ketiv ella chad. aval yemina, la ketiv beh zeroa, ella (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai. (Tehillim 118:15) yemin Adonai itkere, beg kishrin daavahata deachasinu lechulakehon.

Vei tema ha bitlat chalalin mocha degulegalta mishtakkechin. tana, kullehu 3 mitpashshetin, umitkashsheran bechol gufa, vechol gufa itkeshar behane telat, umitkashsheran bidroa yemina. uvegin kach taiv david veamar, (Tehillim 110:1) shev limini. mishshum dehu itchabbar immehon daavahata, veyativ tamman lechuresya shelemata. uvegin kach ketiv (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim vegomer, mishshum deyativ limina. hayeynu dichtiv, (Daniel 12:13) vetanuach vetaamod legoralcha leketz hayyamin, kelomar, keman dezache lachavivuta demalka. zakkaa chulakeh, deman defaris malka yemineh. vekabbil leh techot yemineh. vehay yemina kad yetiv, kishrin itpashsheta.

Uderoa la oshit yedeh (sefer acher vakeshareyn lo atepashetav uderoa lo oshit yativ) bitlat keshirin deamaran. vechad mitarin chayyayvayya, umitpashshetan bealma, mitarin telat acharanin, deinnun dina kashya, veoshit deroa vechad oshit deroa, yad yemina hu, aval itkere (Yeshayahu 51:9) zeroa Adonai, (Devarim 9:29) zeroacha hanetuya (nusach acher telat kishrin itkeshsharu beh veitkalylu telat kishrin dimina utelat kishrin dismala 5 kishrin daavahata deachasinu lechulakehon. vei tema ha 5 challe mocha dagevalegaletaa mishtakkechin. tana kullehu 3 mitpashshetin umitkashsherin bechol gufa vechol gufa itkeshar behane telata umitkashsherin bidroa yemina. vehay yemina kad yativ 3 bitlat kishrin deamaran. vechad chayyayvayya mitarin. mitarin telat acharanin deinnun dina kashya veoshit deroa vaatakeray zeroa Adonai zeroecha hannetuya) bezimna deg ilen itkelilan 5 acharanin, ikre kolla yemina, veavid dina berachame, hada hu dichtiv, yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev, begin demitarin rachame behu.

Vetana, behay yemina mitachadan telat mea veshivin elef ribbo, deikrun yemina. umea vetimnin vachamishsha elef ribbo, mizzeroa deikre zeroa Adonai. mehay umehay talyay zeroa, vehay vehay ikre tiferet, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:12) molich limin moshe, ha yemina. zeroa, ha semala. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:12) zeroa tifarto, da beda.

Vetana, bida semala, mitachadan arba mea vechamshin ribbo mare terisin, mitachadan bechol etzbea veetzbea. uvechol etzbea veetzbea eser alfin mare terisin mishtakkechin. puk vachashov, kama innun devida. vehahu yemina ikre siyyua kaddisha, deati midderoa dimina, mittelat kishrin. (veaf al gav deikre yad have siyyua) dichtiv (uchetiv) (Shmuel 2 3:12) vehinne yadi immach. umitachadan mehay, elef vearba ribbo, utemanya, vechamesh mea alfin marehon desiyyuin bechol alma. veikrun yad Adonai illaa. yad Adonai tattaa. veaf al gav divchol atar yad Adonai semala. zachu yemin Adonai, itkelil yeda bizroa, vahavi siyyua, veikre yamin. vei lav, yad Adonai tattaa. tana, kad mitarin dinin kashyayn leachata bealma, hacha ketiv, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, dechol dinin demishtachchin middechura, takkifin beresha, venayychin besofa. vechol dinin demishtachchin minnukeba, nayychin beresha, vetakkifin besofa. veilmale deitavedu kachada, la yachlin alma lemisbal. ad deattik deattike setima decholla, parish da min da, vechavar lon leitbassema kachada.

Vechad parish lon, appil duremita lizer appin, ufaris lenukeba meachoroy desitroy, veatkin lah kol tikkunaha, veatznea leyoma dileh, lemetaha lidchura. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:21) vayyappel Adonai elohim tardema al haadam vayyishan. mahu vayyishan. hay hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 44:24) ura lamma tishan Adonai. vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav, may achat. da hi nukeba. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati, vesalleka, veittakna. uveatraha shekia rachame vechesed, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:21) vayisgor basar tachtenna. uchetiv (Yechezkel 36:26) vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar.

Uveshaata devaa lemeal shabbeta hava bare ruchin veshedin veilulin, vead la siyyem lon, atat matronita betikkunaha, veyativat kammeh. beshaata deyativat kammeh, anach lon leinnun biryayn, vela ishtelimu. kevan dematronita yatvat im malka,
1316: Veitchabbaru appin beappin, man yeul benayyhu, man hu deyikrav bahadayyhu. (begin kach setima demilla onatan shel talmide chachamim deyadin raza dena mishshabbat lashshabbat.) vechad itchabberu, itbesamu da beda. yoma decholla itbesam beh. uvegin kach, itbesamu dinin da beda, veittekanu illain vetattain.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, baa attika kaddisha lemecheze, i itbesamu dinin, veitdevaku teren illen da beda, venafak missitra denukeba dina takkifa, (dela yachil alma lemisbal) dichtiv, (Bereshit 4:1) vehaadam yada et chavva ishto vattahar vatteled et kayin vattomer kaniti vegomer. vela hava yachil alma lemisbal, mishshum dela itbassemat, vechivya takkifa attil ba zuhama dedina kashya, uvegin kach la hava yachil leitbassema. vechad nafik da kayin missetar denukeba, nafak takkif kashya, takkif bedinoy, kashya bedinoy. kevan denafak itchalashat veitbassemat. batar da, appikat achara besima yattir, vesalik kadmaa dehava takkifa kashya, vechol dinin la itarvu (sefer acher ateareav) kameh (sefer acher vechol dinin 3 ittearu) immeh.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 4:8) vayhi bihyotam bassade. bassade: deishtemoda leella. bassade deikre sade detappuchim. venatzach hay dina laachu, mishshum dehava kashya minneh, veachpeyeh veatmereh techoteh. ad deittear behay kudesha berich hu, veabereh mikkammeh. veshakeh benukeba dithoma rabba. vechalil laachuy beshikkua deyamma rabba, dimvassem dimin illain. uminnehon nachtin nishmatin lealma, eynash lefum orchoy.

Veaf al gav ditmirin innun. mitpashshetin da beda, veitavidu gufa chad umehay gufa, nachtin nishmathon derashiayyay chayyayvayya, takife rucha. mittarvivyhon kachada salleka datach. ella da lesitroy, veda lesitroy. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dimshalfe nishmathon mehay gufa kaddisha deikre adam, dechalil kolla, atar deitrin vechitrin kaddishin mitchabberan tamman, bitzrora deatkela (sefer acher deatkala).

Zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, (sefer acher attun chavrayyay) dechol hane millin kaddishin, deitmaru beruach kaddisha illaa, ruach dechol kaddishin illain itkallelan beh, itgalyayn lechu. millin deillain vetattain tzayytin lehu, zakkain attun marehon demarin, mechatzde chakla, demillin illen tindeun vetistakkelun behu, vetindeun lemarechon appin beappin, ena beena. uvehane millin tizkun lealma deate, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:39) veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha vegomer. Adonai: attik yomin hu haelohim. vecholla hu chad, berich shemeh lealam ulealme almayya.
Amar rabbi shimon, chamena illain letatta, vetattain leella. illain letatta, diyyukena deadam, dehu tikkune illaa, kelala dechullehu. (chaser)
Tana, ketiv (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam, dechalil shit bekartufa kachada. vehay hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) shokav ammude shesh.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, baadam itkelilu kitrin illain, bichlal uvifrat. uveadam itkelilu kitrin tattain, bifrat uchelal. kitrin illain bichlal, kema deittemar bediyyukena dechol hane tikkunin (sefer acher diukenin). bifrat: beetzbean diydin, chamesh keneged chamesh. kitrin tattain, beetzbein deraglin deinnun perat uchelal. deha gufa la itchaze bahadayyhu. deinnun levar miggufa. uvegin kach la havo begufa. degufa adiu minnayyhu.

I hachi, may (Zecharya 14:4) veamdu raglav bayom hahu. ella raglav degufa, marehon dedinin (sefer acher dameareyn) lemebad nukemin veikrun baale raglayim. uminnehon takkifin. umitachadan marehon dedinin di letatta, bechitrin tattain.

Tana, kol innun tikkune dilella, divgufa kaddisha, (badekar venukeba) kelala deadam, itmeshich da min da, umitachadan da beda, veashkun da leda. kema deitmeshach dama bekitfin devaridin leda uleda, lehacha ulehacha, meatar da leatar achara, veinnun mashkin (sefer acher kasetayn) degufa (nusach acher legufa). ashkeyayn da leda, menaharin da leda. ad deanhiru kullehu almin, umitbarchan beginehon.
1317: Dela itkelilu begufa, kullehu rechikin umesaavin, umesaavan kol man deyikrav legabbehon, leminda minnehon millin.

Tana, may tiuveta dilhon legabbe talmide chachamim. ella mishshum dechaman behu gufa kaddisha, uleitkalla behu behahu gufa. vechi tema, i hachi, ha malachin kaddishin velethon bichlala degufa. la. dechas veshalom i lehevon levar mikkelala degufa kaddisha, la havo kaddishin vela mitkayyme. uchetiv (Daniel 10:6) ugeviyyayto chetarshish. uchetiv (Yechezkel 1:18) vegabbotam meleot enayim. (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel. kullehu bichlala deadam. bar mehane delethon bichlala degufa, deinnun misavin, umesaavan kol man deyikrav bahadayyhu.

Vetana, kullehu merucha dismala, dela itbesam beadam mishtakkechin, venafku mikkelala degufa kaddisha, vela itdavaku beh. uvegin kach kullehu misavin veazlin vetasin alma, veayylin benukeba dithoma rabba, leitdabbeka behahu dina kadmaa deikre kayin, denafik bichlal degufa diltatta. veshatin vetasin kol alma, ufarchan vela mitdabbekan bichlala degufa, uvegine kach innun levar, mikkol mashiryayn dilella vetatta. misavin innun. behu ketiv (Vayikra 13:46) michutz lammachane moshavo.

Uverucha deikre hevel, deitbassam yattir bichlala degufa kaddisha. nafkin acharanin demibbasman yattir, umitdabbekan begufa, vela mitdabbekan. kullehu talyayn (76 amud bet) baavira venafkin mehay kelala deillen misavin. veshamin ma deshamin meella, uminnayyhu yade letatta dekaamre lehu.

Vetana bitzniuta desifra, kevan deitbesamu leella kelala deadam, gufa kaddisha, dechar venukeba. itchabbaru zimna telitaa, venafak itbassemuta decholla. veitbesamu almin illain vetattain. umikkan ishtachlal alma dilella vetatta, missitra degufa kaddisha. umitchabberan almin, umitachadan da beda, veitavidu chad gufa. (uvegin dechullehu chad gufa, shechinta leella, shechinta letatta, kudesha berich hu leella, kudesha berich hu 831) umeshallefa rucha, veayyla bechad gufa. uvechullehu la itchaze ella chad. (Yeshayahu 6:3) kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot melo kol haaretz kevodo. decholla hu chad gufa.

Tana, kevan deitbesamu da beda, (ketiv 0 tore zahav naase lecha im nekudot hakkesef) itkashsharu dina verachame. (atebasemaa dina berachame) veitbassemat nukeba bidchura. uvegine kach la salleka da belo da, kehay tamar, dela salleka da belo da. veal hay tanenan, man deappik garmeh behay alma mikkelala deadam, levatar kad nafik mehay alma, la ayel bichlala deadam, deikre gufa kaddisha. ella beinnun dela ikrun adam, venafik mikkelala degufa.

Tanya, tore zahav naase lach im nekudot hakkasef, deitbesamu dina berachame. velet dina, dela havo beh rachame. veal hay ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:10) navu lechayayich battorim tzavvarech bacharuzim. battorim: kemo dichtiv, tore zahav naase lach vegomer. bacharuzim: kema dichtiv, im nekudot hakkasef. tzavvarech, bichlala denukeba, da matronita ishtechach be makdesha dilella, viyrushalam diltatta (sefer acher umikdesha decholla) umakdesha. vechol da miditbesamat bidchura, veitavid kelala deadam, veda hu kelala dimhemnuta. may mehemnuta. divgavvih ishtechach kol mehemnuta.

(Shayych parashat ki tetze) vetana, man deikre adam, venishmeta nafkat minneh, umit. asir lemevat leh beveta, lemebad leh lina al ara, mishshum yekara dehay gufa, dela yitchaze beh kelana, dichtiv, (Tehillim 49:13) adam bikar bal yalin, adam dehu yakar mikkol yekara, bal yalin. may tama. mishshum dei yaavdun hachi, nimshal kabbehemot nidmu. ma beire la havo bichlala deadam, vela itchaze behu rucha kaddisha, uf hacha kivire, gufa bela rucha, vehay gufa, dehu yekara decholla, la yitchaze beh kelana.
Vetana bitzniuta desifra, kol man deavid lina lehay gufa kaddisha, bela rucha, avid pegimuta begufa dealmin. deha begin
1318: Da, la avid lina beatra kaddisha, beara detzedek yalin bah, (sefer acher dechitra kaddisha demalka beara dichtiv 0 tzedek yalin bah) mishshum dehay gufa yekara, itkere diyyukena demalka. vei avid beh lina, havi kechad min beire. (hada hu dichtiv, 1 nimshal kabbehemot 2 nidmu)

Tana, (Bereshit 6:2) vayyiru vene haelohim et benot haadam. (sefer acher bene haelohim) innun (60 amud bet) deitmaru, venaflu benukeba dithoma rabba. et benot haadam, (haadam hayyadua). uchetiv veyaldu lahem hemma haggibborim asher meolam vegomer. mehahu deikre olam. kidtanenan yeme olam. anshe hashshem, minnehon nafku ruchin veshedin lealma, leitdabbeka berashiayay.
Hannefilim hayu vaaretz, leappaka illen acharanin. dela havo baaretz. hannefilim: azza veazzael havo baaretz. bene haelohim la havo baaretz. veraza hu vecholla ittemar.

Ketiv (Bereshit 6:6) vayyinnachem Adonai ki asa et haadam baaretz, leappaka adam dilella, dela havi baaretz. vayyinachem Adonai hay bizer appin ittemar. vayyitatztzev el libbo, vayyetzav lo neemar. ella vayyitatztzev, ihu itatztzav, deveh talyay milleta. laappuke mimman dela itatztzav. el libbo, belibbo la ketiv, ella el libbo. keman deitatztzav (umekabbel) lemareh, deachze hay lelibba dechol libbin.
Vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam asher barati meal pene haadama vegomer. leappaka adam dilella. vei tema adam diltatta bilchodoy. lav leappaka kelal. mishshum dela kaim da bela da.
Veilmale chachma setima decholla, kolla ittakkan kemeresha. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:12) ani chachma shachanti arma. al tikre shachanti, ella shechinatti (sefer acher shaykanetay).
Veilmale hay tikkuna deadam, la kaim alma. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:19) Adonai bechachma yasad aretz. uchetiv (Bereshit 6:8) venach matza chen beene Adonai.

Vetana, kullehu mochin talyayn behay mocha. vehachachma hu kelala decholla hu. veda chachma setima, devah ittakif veittakkan tikkuna deadam, leityayshsheva kolla al tikkuneh, kol chad beatreh. hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:19) hachachma taoz lechacham measara shallitim, deinnun tikkuna shelema deadam. veadam hu tikkuna dilgo, minneh kaim rucha. (hada hu dichtiv, 1 ki haadam yire laenayim vayhva yire lallevav, deihu balegav lego)

Uvehay tikkuna deadam, itchaze shelemuta mehemnuta decholla, dekaim al kuresyyay. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:26-27) udemut kemare adam alav milmala. uchetiv (Daniel 7:13) vaaru im anane shemaya kevar enash ate hava vead attik yomayya meta ukedamohi hakervuhi. ad kan setiman millin. uveriran taamin. zakkaa chulakeh deman deyada veyashgach behon. vela yite behon. demillin illen la ityehivu, ella lemare medin umechatzde chakla, dealu venafku. dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam.

Tana, bacha rabbi shimon, vearim kaleh veamar, i bemillin dilan, deitgalleyayn hacha, itgenizu chavrayyay beiddara dealma deate, veistellaku mehay alma, yaut veshappir hava, begin dela itgalleyayn lechad mibbene alma. hadar veamar, haderi bi, deha galle kammeh deattika deattikin, setima dechol setimin, deha la likara dili avidna, vela likara devet abba, vela likara dechavrayyay illen, ella begin dela yitun beorchoy, vela yaalun bechissufa letare palteroy, vela yimmechun bidehon. zakkaa chulaki immehon, lealma deate.

Tana, ad la nafku chavrayay mehahu iddara, mitu (160 amud alef amud alef) ribbi yose baribbi yaakov, veribbi chizkiyya, veribbi yesa. vechamu chavrayyay, dahavo natlin lon malachin kaddishin behahu parsa. veamar rabbi shimon milla, veishtechachu. tzavavch veamar, shemma chas veshalom gezera itgezar alana leitannesha, deitgele al yedana ma dela itgele miyyoma dekaim moshe al tura desinay, dichtiv, (Shemot 34:28) vayhi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla vegomer. ma ana hacha. i begin da itanashu.
Shama kala, zakkaa ant rabbi shimon, zakkaa chulakach vechavrayyay, illen dekayymin bahadach, deha itgele lechon ma dela itgele lechol chela dilella,
1319: Aval ta chaze, deha ketiv, (Yehoshua 6:26) bivchoro yeyassedenna uvitziro yatztziv delateha. vekol shekken deviru saggi vetakkif, itdavaku nafshathon beshaata da deitnesivu. zakkaa chulakehon, deha bishlemuta istalaku. (dela hava ken leinun dahavo kammayyhu, amay mitu)

Tana, beod deitgalleyayn millin, itregisho illain vetattain, (deinnun retichin) vekala ittear bematan vechamshin almin deha millin attikin letatta itgalyayn, vead (nusach acher veod) deillen mitbasseman nishmatayyhu beinnun millin, nafka nishmatayyhu binshika, veitkashshar behahu parsa, venatlin lehu malache illae, vesallekin lon leella. vaamay illen. mishshum dealun vela nafku zimna achara min kadmat dena, vechullehu acharine alu venafku.

Amar rabbi shimon, kama zakkaa chulakehon dehane telata, vezakkaa chulakana lealma deate begin da. nafak kala tinyaynut veamar, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kulchem hayyom. kamu veazlu. bechol atar dahavo mistakkele salik rechin. amar rabbi shimon shema minnah, dealma mitberach beginan. vahavu naharin anpoy dechullehu, vela havo yachlin bene alma leistakkela behu.

Tana, asara alu, vesheva nafku, vahava chadde rabbi shimon. veribbi abba atziv. yoma chad hava yativ rabbi shimon veribbi abba immeh, amar rabbi shimon milla, vechamu leillen telata dahavo mayytin lehon malachin illain, umechazyayn lehu genizin veiddarin dilella, begin yekara dilhon. vahavu ayyle lon beture deafarsemona dachya. nach dateh deribbi abba.

Tana, mehahu yoma la adu chavrayyay mibbe rabbi shimon. vechad hava rabbi shimon megalle razin, la mishtakkechin tamman ella innun. vahava kare lehu ribbi shimon, shiva anan ene Adonai. dichtiv, (Zecharya 4:10) shiva elle ene Adonai vealan ittemar. amar ribbi abba, anan shita botzine, denaharan mishsheviaa. ant hu sheviaa decholla. deha let kiuma leshita, bar mishsheviaa. decholla tale bishviaa. ribbi yehuda kare leh shabbat, dechullehu shita minneh mitbarchin, dichtiv, (Shemot 20:10) shabbat laAdonai, kodesh laAdonai, ma shabbat laAdonai kodesh, uf rabbi shimon shabbat laAdonai kodesh.

Amar rabbi shimon, tavvavhna al hahu chagir chartzan, mareh desare, amay la ishtechach beve iddara dilan, bezimna deitgalleyayn millin illen kaddishin. addehachi, ata eliyyahu, utelat katfore nehirin beanpoy. amar leh rabbi shimon, may tama la shechiach mor bekarduta (sefer acher bakeratemaa) gelifa demareh, beyoma dehillula.

Amar leh, chayyecha ribbi sheva yomin itberiru kammeh kudesha berich hu, kol innun deyetun veyishtachchun immeh, al la ayiltun beve iddara dilchon, uvaena leishtakkecha, zammin katir bechatfoy (sefer acher 80 shekken tzarich lomar, vaana hava zammin tamman, uvaena kammeh leishtakkecha, ucheden katir baketapevay) vela yachilna, dehahu yoma shadarni kudesha berich hu, lemebad nissin lerav hamenuna sava vechavroy, deitmesaru bearmona (sefer acher bakeravenaya) demalka, vearchishna lehu benissa, deramena lehu kotala dehechala demalka, veitketaru bekitroy, demitu arbaim vachamishsha pardashke. vaappikna lerav hamenuna vechavroy veramena (sefer acher vaavaleykenaa) lon levikat ono, veishtezivu. vezaminna kammayyhu nahama umayyay, dela achlu telata yomin. vechol hahu yoma la badilna minnayyhu.

Vechad tavna, ashkachna parsa denatlu kol innun samchin, utelat min chavrayyay alah, veshailna lon. veamru chulaka dekudesha berich hu, mehillula derabbi shimon vechavroy. zakkaa ant rabbi shimon, vezakkaa chulakach, vechulaka deinnun chavrayyay deyatvin kammach. kama dargin ittakanu lechon lealma deate. kama botzinin dinhorin zeminin lenahara lechu.

Veta chaze, yoma den beginach itattaru chamshin kitrin leribbi pinchas ben yair chamuch. vaana azilna immeh bechol innun nahare deture deafarsemona dachya, vehu barir ducheteh, veittakkan. (sefer acher vaana ha chazena deha barir vechulei) amar leh, keturin tzaddikayyay bekartufa deitrin,
